title_en: Segment-driven Structural Induction and Semantic Alignment for Heterogeneous Tabular Representation
title_zh: 面向异构表格表示的段驱动结构归纳与语义对齐

sentences.en: Real-world domains often contain heterogeneous tables whose headers vary while their underlying attribute semantics are shared, making it difficult to induce domain-specialized semantics from table-local evidence alone.
sentences.zh: 现实领域通常包含异构表格，这些表格的表头各不相同，而其底层的属性语义却是共享的，这使得仅依据表内证据难以归纳出领域特化的语义。

sentences.en: Existing encoders model parts of this problem, but often underuse column-level value distributions and apply uniform objectives across attributes with different semantic roles.
sentences.zh: 现有的编码器对这一问题进行了部分建模，但往往未能充分利用列级取值分布，并对具有不同语义角色的属性施加统一的目标。

sentences.en: We propose NAVI, a segment-centric pretraining framework that treats each header–value pair as the unit for aggregating schema-level structural evidence and column-level distributional evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了NAVI，一个以段为中心的预训练框架，将每个表头-取值对视为聚合模式级结构证据和列级分布证据的单元。

sentences.en: We realize this design through Masked Segment Modeling and Entropy-driven Segment Alignment, which jointly enforce structured header–value coupling and semantic alignment across stable and instance-specific attributes.
sentences.zh: 我们通过掩码段建模和熵驱动段对齐来实现这一设计，两者共同在稳定属性和实例特定属性上强制执行结构化的表头-取值耦合和语义对齐。

sentences.en: Experiments on heterogeneous in-domain tables show improved reconstruction, semantic consistency, and downstream utility across evaluation settings overall.
sentences.zh: 在异构域内表格上的实验表明，我们的方法在各项评估设置下总体上改进了重建、语义一致性和下游实用性。

title_en: Segmentation From Attention: Training-Free Layer Selection and One-Shot Tuning for Segmentation in VLMs
title_zh: 从注意力中分割：VLM中免训练层选择与一次性微调的分割

sentences.en: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs), trained on extensive datasets of image-text pairs, exhibit strong multimodal understanding capabilities by implicitly learning associations between textual descriptions and image regions.
sentences.zh: 在图文对的广规模数据集上训练的大型视觉-语言模型（VLM），通过隐式学习文本描述与图像区域之间的关联，展现出强大的多模态理解能力。

sentences.en: This emergent ability enables zero-shot object detection and segmentation, using techniques that rely on text-image attention maps, without necessarily training on abundant labeled segmentation datasets.
sentences.zh: 这种涌现能力使零样本目标检测和分割成为可能，利用的是一些依赖文本-图像注意力映射的技术，而无需在大量标注的分割数据集上训练。

sentences.en: However, performance of such methods depends heavily on prompt engineering and manually selected layers or head choices for the attention layers.
sentences.zh: 然而，此类方法的性能在很大程度上依赖于提示工程，以及手动选择的注意力层或头部选择。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a training-free entropy-based measure, InfoScore, to identify the best image-text attention layers for segmentation, providing a more flexible and scalable solution for training-free open-vocabulary segmentation, reducing the additional burden of hyperparamter search.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种免训练的基于熵的度量InfoScore，用于识别最适合分割的图像-文本注意力层，为免训练的开放词汇分割提供了一种更灵活、可扩展的解决方案，并减少了额外的超参数搜索负担。

sentences.en: We empirically show that our training-free selection strategy is superior to naive selection strategies.
sentences.zh: 我们通过实验表明，我们的免训练选择策略优于朴素的选策策略。

sentences.en: Additionally, we demonstrate that instead of solely relying on text prompts, fine-tuning the image-text attention layer with a single visual example of each class significantly improves segmentation without the need of additional parameters or decoders.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明，与其仅仅依赖文本提示，用每个类别的单个视觉示例对图像-文本注意力层进行微调，可以显著改进分割，而无需额外参数或解码器。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that our methods and findings are general and can be applied across various vision-language models (VLMs).
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明我们的方法和发现具有通用性，可应用于各种视觉-语言模型（VLM）。

title_en: SegPVSG: Panoptic Video Scene Graph Generation via Temporal Focusing and Generative Augmentation
title_zh: SegPVSG：通过时间聚焦和生成式增强的全景视频场景图生成

sentences.en: Panoptic Video Scene Graph Generation (PVSG) aims to identify relations between pixel-level entities in a video, serving as a novel paradigm for structured video parsing.
sentences.zh: 全景视频场景图生成（PVSG）旨在识别视频中像素级实体之间的关系，是结构化视频解析的一种新颖范式。

sentences.en: However, this task faces two key challenges.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一任务面临两个关键挑战。

sentences.en: First, the interactions between entities are temporally fragmented and sparse, meaning videos are dominated by irrelevant content with limited salient information.
sentences.zh: 首先，实体之间的交互在时间上是碎片化且稀疏的，这意味着视频以无关内容为主，显著信息有限。

sentences.en: Second, the distribution of relations exhibits a significant long-tailed pattern, making models struggle to perform well on tail categories with insufficient data.
sentences.zh: 其次，关系的分布呈现出显著的长尾模式，使得模型在数据不足的尾部类别上难以表现出色。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose SegPVSG, an innovative, temporal-segment-aware PVSG framework consisting of two key components: TempFocusNet (TFN) and Relation-centric Generative Video Augmentation (RGVA) module.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了SegPVSG，一个创新的、具有时间分段时间感知能力的PVSG框架，由两个关键组件组成：TempFocusNet（TFN）和关系中心生成式视频增强（RGVA）模块。

sentences.en: TFN is a localization-then-recognition network that improves PVSG performance by explicitly localizing and focusing on salient segments before relation recognition.
sentences.zh: TFN是一个先定位后识别的网络，通过在关系识别前显式地定位并聚焦显著片段来提升PVSG性能。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, RGVA is a novel augmentation module that generates realistic, context-consistent video segments for rare relations and coherently inserts them into original videos.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，RGVA是一个新颖的增强模块，为罕见关系生成逼真且上下文一致的视频片段，并将其连贯地插入原始视频中。

sentences.en: Our method outperforms prior methods by +3.53 mR@20 and +5.9 mR@50, demonstrating its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法以+3.53 mR@20和+5.9 mR@50的优势胜过先前方法，证明了其有效性。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/ticatt/SegPVSG.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ticatt/SegPVSG 获取。

title_en: SeisMark: A Large-Scale Open Benchmark for Robust 3D Seismic Fault Detection
title_zh: SeisMark：用于稳健3D地震断层检测的大规模开放基准

sentences.en: We introduce SeisMark, a large-scale open benchmark designed to bridge the gap between verifiable ground truth and realistic texture in 3D seismic fault detection.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了SeisMark，一个大规模开放基准，旨在弥合可验证真值与真实纹理之间的差距，用于3D地震断层检测。

sentences.en: Using a novel pipeline merging procedural geology with diffusion-based synthesis, we produce domain-realistic (survey-specific) textured volumes that expose significant brittleness in existing models masked by simplified physics data.
sentences.zh: 利用一种将程序化地质与基于扩散的合成相结合的新颖流程，我们生成了领域真实（特定勘探区）的纹理化体数据，这些数据暴露了现有模型在简化物理数据掩盖下存在的显著脆性。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that SeisMark acts as a rigorous discriminator, distinguishing robust modern architecture from legacy model that suffers performance collapse under realistic domain shifts.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，SeisMark是一个严格的判别器，能够将稳健的现代架构与在真实域偏移下性能崩溃的旧模型区分开来。

sentences.en: We release this benchmark to the community to serve as a verifiable standard for developing trustworthy, deployment-ready AI for safety-critical subsurface applications.
sentences.zh: 我们将该基准发布给社区，作为开发安全关键地下应用中可信、可部署AI的可验证标准。

title_en: Seizure-Semiology-Suite($S^3$): A Clinically Multimodal Dataset, Benchmark, and Models for Seizure Semiology Understanding
title_zh: 发作语义学套件（$S^3$）：面向发作语义学理解的临床多模态数据集、基准与模型

sentences.en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in general video understanding, their capacity to interpret involuntary, and spatio-temporally evolving pathologic motor behaviors such as seizure semiology remains largely untested.
sentences.zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在通用视频理解方面展现出非凡的能力，但它们解读非自主的、在时空上演化的病理性运动行为（如发作语义学）的能力在很大程度上仍未得到检验。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce Seizure-Semiology-Suite (S³), a clinically grounded dataset and benchmark for fine-grained, structured seizure semiology understanding.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们引入了发作语义学套件（S³），一个基于临床的数据集和基准，用于细粒度、结构化的发作语义学理解。

sentences.en: The dataset includes 438 seizure videos annotated with over 35,000 dense labels covering 20 ILAE-defined semiological features.
sentences.zh: 该数据集包含438个发作视频，标注了超过35000个密集标签，涵盖20个ILAE定义的语义特征。

sentences.en: Building on this dataset, we propose a seven-task hierarchical benchmark that systematically evaluates MLLMs from low-level visual perception to temporal sequencing, narrative report generation, and seizure diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 在此数据集基础上，我们提出了一个七任务的分层基准，系统性地评估MLLM从低级视觉感知到时间排序、叙述报告生成和发作诊断的能力。

sentences.en: To enable clinically meaningful evaluation of generated reports, we further introduce the Report Quality Index for Seizure Semiology (Seizure-RQI).
sentences.zh: 为对生成的报告进行具有临床意义的评估，我们进一步引入了发作语义学报告质量指数（Seizure-RQI）。

sentences.en: Extensive baselines across 11 open-weight MLLMs reveal systematic weaknesses in laterality reasoning, temporal localization, symptom sequencing, and clinically faithful reporting.
sentences.zh: 在11个开源权重MLLM上的大量基线结果揭示了其在侧别推理、时间定位、症状排序和临床忠实报告方面的系统性弱点。

sentences.en: We show that seizure-specific fine-tuning substantially improves performance across tasks, and that a two-stage neuro-symbolic framework achieves an F1 score of 0.96 on epileptic versus non-epileptic seizure classification.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，面向发作的特定微调显著提升了各项任务的性能，并且一个两阶段神经符号框架在癫痫与非癫痫发作分类上达到了0.96的F1分数。

sentences.en: Seizure-Semiology-Suite establishes a rigorous benchmark for evaluating multimodal models in safety-critical medical video understanding and guides the development of clinically reliable, domain-adaptive multimodal intelligence.
sentences.zh: 发作语义学套件为评估多模态模型在安全关键医疗视频理解中的表现建立了严格的基准，并指导临床可靠、领域自适应的多模态智能的发展。

title_en: Select to Think: Unlocking SLM Potential with Local Sufficiency
title_zh: 选择以思考：以局部充分性释放小语言模型潜力

sentences.en: Small language models (SLMs) offer efficient deployment, yet they often lag behind their larger counterparts (LLMs) in reasoning.
sentences.zh: 小语言模型（SLM）提供高效的部署，但在推理能力上常常落后于更大的模型（LLM）。

sentences.en: Existing remedies either invoke an LLM at points of reasoning divergence, incurring substantial latency and cost, or rely on standard distillation, which is limited by the SLM's capacity to accurately mimic the LLM's complex generative distribution.
sentences.zh: 现有的解决方案要么在推理分歧点调用LLM，带来显著的延迟和成本，要么依赖标准的蒸馏，但后者受限于SLM准确模仿LLM复杂生成分布的能力。

sentences.en: We address this dilemma by identifying local sufficiency: at divergence points, the LLM's preferred token often resides within the SLM's top-$K$ next-token predictions, even when failing to emerge as the SLM top-1 choice.
sentences.zh: 我们通过识别局部充分性来解决这一困境：在分歧点，LLM偏好的token往往存在于SLM的前K个下一token预测中，即使它未能成为SLM的top-1选择。

sentences.en: We therefore propose Select to Think (S2T), which reframes the LLM’s role from open-ended generation to selection among the SLM's proposals, simplifying the supervision signal to discrete candidate rankings.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出选择以思考（S2T），将LLM的角色从开放式生成重新定义为在SLM的提案中进行选择，将监督信号简化为离散的候选排序。

sentences.en: Leveraging this, we introduce S2T-Local, which distills the selection logic into the SLM, empowering it to perform autonomous re-ranking without inference-time LLM dependency.
sentences.zh: 利用这一点，我们引入了S2T-Local，将选择逻辑蒸馏到SLM中，使其能够在无需推理时LLM依赖的情况下进行自主重排序。

sentences.en: Empirically, a 1.5B SLM's top-8 candidates contain the 32B LLM's choice with a 95\% hit rate, and S2T-Local improves the 1.5B SLM's Math Avg. over greedy decoding by 24.1\% relative gain, matching the efficacy of 8-path self-consistency with single-trajectory efficiency.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，一个1.5B SLM的前8个候选中包含32B LLM的选择，命中率达95\%；S2T-Local将1.5B SLM的数学平均得分相比贪心解码提高了24.1\%的相对增益，以单轨迹的效率达到了8路径自洽的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YeRona/Select-to-Think.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YeRona/Select-to-Think 获取。

title_en: Selecting Samples on Graphs: A Unified Dataset Pruning Framework for Lossless Training Acceleration
title_zh: 在图上选择样本：用于无损训练加速的统一数据集剪枝框架

sentences.en: The rapid growth of modern training datasets has significantly increased computational cost, motivating dataset pruning~(DP) methods which retain only a subset of informative samples to reduce training cost.
sentences.zh: 现代训练数据集的快速增长显著增加了计算成本，由此催生了数据集剪枝（DP）方法，这类方法仅保留一部分信息量大的样本以降低训练成本。

sentences.en: Existing pruning criteria typically rely on either intrinsic signals that assess samples independently or extrinsic signals that promote diversity via pairwise relations.
sentences.zh: 现有的剪枝准则通常要么依赖独立评估样本的内在信号，要么依赖通过成对关系促进多样性的外在信号。

sentences.en: While effective in their own specific regimes, each captures only one aspect of sample utility and lacks robustness across different pruning ratios or data distribution.
sentences.zh: 虽然它们在各自特定的场景中有效，但每种准则只捕捉了样本效用的一方面，在不同剪枝比例或数据分布下缺乏稳健性。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a unified graph-based DP framework.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个统一的基于图的数据集剪枝框架。

sentences.en: By modeling the dataset as a weighted graph, where node weights encode intrinsic value and edge weights encode extrinsic value, DP can be cast as a Maximum Weight Clique Problem (MWCP).
sentences.zh: 通过将数据集建模为加权图（节点权重编码内在价值，边权重编码外在价值），数据集剪枝可以被形式化为最大权重团问题（MWCP）。

sentences.en: Although MWCP is NP-hard, its structure admits a principled greedy solution based on sample-wise marginal gains.
sentences.zh: 虽然MWCP是NP难的，但其结构允许基于样本边际收益的原则性贪心求解。

sentences.en: Under a few mild conditions, we further prove that this unified objective enjoys a formal approximation guarantee, which applies to a broad family of importance metrics and provides practical design guidelines.
sentences.zh: 在几个温和条件下，我们进一步证明该统一目标具有正式的近似保证，该保证适用于一大类重要性度量，并提供了实用的设计指南。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing DP methods while substantially reducing training cost, reducing training time by over 40\% without sacrificing accuracy on ImageNet-1k with ResNet-50.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的数据集剪枝方法，同时大幅降低训练成本：在ImageNet-1k上使用ResNet-50时，训练时间减少了40\%以上，且准确率无损。

title_en: Selective Concept Bottleneck Models Without Predefined Concepts
title_zh: 无需预定义概念的选择性概念瓶颈模型

sentences.en: Concept-based models like Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have garnered significant interest for improving model interpretability by first predicting human-understandable concepts before mapping them to the output classes.
sentences.zh: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）等基于概念的方法因先预测人类可理解的概念、再将其映射到输出类别而提升了模型可解释性，引起了广泛关注。

sentences.en: Early approaches required costly concept annotations.
sentences.zh: 早期方法需要昂贵的概念标注。

sentences.en: To alleviate this, recent methods utilized large language models to automatically generate class-specific concept descriptions and learned mappings from a pretrained black-box model’s raw features to these concepts using vision-language models.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，近期方法利用大语言模型自动生成类特定的概念描述，并使用视觉-语言模型从预训练黑盒模型的原始特征学习到这些概念的映射。

sentences.en: However, these approaches assume prior knowledge of which concepts the black-box model has learned.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法假设已知黑盒模型学习了哪些概念的先验知识。

sentences.en: In this work, we discover the concepts encoded by the model through unsupervised concept discovery techniques instead.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们转而通过无监督概念发现技术来发现模型编码的概念。

sentences.en: We further leverage a simple input-dependent concept selection mechanism that dynamically retains a sparse set of relevant concepts of each input, enhancing both sparsity and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步利用一种简单的输入依赖概念选择机制，动态保留每个输入的一组稀疏的相关概念，增强了稀疏性和可解释性。

sentences.en: Our approach not only improves downstream performance, but also needs significantly fewer concepts for accurate classification.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法不仅提升了下游性能，而且需要的概念数量显著减少即可实现准确分类。

sentences.en: Lastly, we show how large vision-language models can guide the editing of our models' weights to correct model errors.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们展示了大型视觉-语言模型如何指导我们模型权重的编辑以纠正模型错误。

title_en: Selective Coupling of Decoupled Informative Regions: Masked Attention Alignment for Data-Free Quantization of Vision Transformers
title_zh: 解耦信息区域的选择性耦合：面向视觉Transformer无数据量化的掩码注意力对齐

sentences.en: Data-Free Quantization (DFQ) addresses data security concerns by synthesizing samples, without accessing real data.
sentences.zh: 无数据量化（DFQ）通过合成样本解决数据安全问题，而无需访问真实数据。

sentences.en: It has garnered increasing attention in the context of Vision Transformers (ViTs), owing to the superiority of the self-attention mechanism compared to classical convolutional operation.
sentences.zh: 由于自注意力机制相比经典卷积运算的优势，DFQ在视觉Transformer（ViT）的语境下越来越受关注。

sentences.en: However, previous DFQ arts for ViTs often suffer from a distribution mismatch between synthetic samples and input distribution expected by quantized models $Q$, resulting in the suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前针对ViT的DFQ方法往往面临合成样本与量化模型$Q$所期望的输入分布之间的分布失配问题，导致性能次优。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel Masked Attention Alignment approach for Data-Free Quantization of ViTs, named MaskAQ, revealing that: 1) the semantics in the self-attention mechanism is predominantly localized to a sparse subset of patches, called informative regions;
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种面向ViT无数据量化的新颖掩码注意力对齐方法，命名为MaskAQ，揭示了：1）自注意力机制中的语义主要局限于一个稀疏的补丁子集，称为信息区域；

sentences.en: 2) the informative regions dominate the mutual information between synthetic samples and $Q$'s outputs.
sentences.zh: 2）信息区域主导着合成样本与$Q$输出之间的互信息。

sentences.en: To these ends, we incorporate differential entropy maximum over patch similarity of synthetic samples, to decouple informative regions from noisy background.
sentences.zh: 为实现这些目标，我们在合成样本的补丁相似性上引入差分熵最大化，以将信息区域从噪声背景中解耦出来。

sentences.en: To couple with varied $Q$, the informative regions are selected to align full-precision models with $Q$ via a masked attention alignment objective, thus yielding high-quality synthetic samples.
sentences.zh: 为了与不同的$Q$耦合，通过掩码注意力对齐目标选择信息区域，使全精度模型与$Q$对齐，从而产生高质量的合成样本。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a periodic sample refreshing strategy comes up to endow MaskAQ with the capacity to continually adapt to the evolving state of $Q$ throughout the training process, to preserve desirable mutual information with synthetic samples.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一种周期性样本刷新策略，使MaskAQ能够在整个训练过程中持续适应$Q$的演化状态，以保持与合成样本之间的理想互信息。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments verify the merits of MaskAQ over state-of-the-art approaches across multiple backbones and downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了MaskAQ在多个骨干网络和下游任务上优于最先进的方法。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/hfutqian/MaskAQ.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/hfutqian/MaskAQ 获取。

title_en: Selective Deferred Routing: Enabling Cost-Efficient Collaboration between Local SLMs and Remote LLMs
title_zh: 选择性延迟路由：实现本地SLM与远程LLM之间的成本高效协作

sentences.en: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has led to remarkable performance across diverse domains, making them indispensable assistants in daily life and work.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展在多个领域带来了卓越的性能，使其成为日常生活和工作中的不可或缺的助手。

sentences.en: Currently, LLM services are primarily accessed in two ways: (i) paid access to cloud-hosted LLMs, which are powerful but introduce nontrivial cost; and (ii) deployment of small language models (SLMs) on personal devices or small clusters, which, while less powerful, are sufficient for handling relatively simple tasks.
sentences.zh: 目前，LLM服务主要通过两种方式访问：（i）付费访问云托管的LLM，这类模型功能强大但会产生不小的成本；（ii）在个人设备或小型集群上部署小语言模型（SLM），这类模型虽然能力较弱，但足以处理相对简单的任务。

sentences.en: To achieve a balanced trade-off between monetary cost and task performance, we propose Selective Deferred Routing, a paradigm that enables cost-efficient collaboration between local SLMs and remote LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为在货币成本与任务性能之间取得平衡，我们提出了选择性延迟路由，一种实现本地SLM与远程LLM之间成本高效协作的范式。

sentences.en: In this framework, a user request is first processed by the local SLM, which not only generates a preliminary response but also provides rich semantic representations of the request.
sentences.zh: 在该框架中，用户请求首先由本地SLM处理，它不仅生成初步回答，还提供请求的丰富语义表示。

sentences.en: A lightweight decision module then leverages this information to either adopt the initial response or route the request to the most suitable remote LLM for a higher-quality response.
sentences.zh: 一个轻量级的决策模块随后利用这些信息，要么采纳初始回答，要么将该请求路由到最合适的远程LLM以产生更高质量的答案。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse model architectures and families, including both SLMs and LLMs, as well as datasets spanning multiple task scenarios, demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing multi-LLM collaboration methods under a wide range of cost–performance trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 在包括SLM和LLM在内的多种模型架构与家族上，以及覆盖多个任务场景的数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法在广泛的成本-性能权衡区间内始终优于现有的多LLM协作方法。

title_en: Selective Disclosure Watermarking for Large Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型的选择性披露水印

sentences.en: Watermarking methods embed imperceptible and verifiable signals into text generated by large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 水印方法将不可感知且可验证的信号嵌入到大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本中。

sentences.en: Existing approaches include zero-bit schemes for distinguishing synthetic text from human writing and multi-bit schemes for embedding metadata.
sentences.zh: 现有方法包括用于区分合成文本与人类写作的零比特方案，以及用于嵌入元数据的多比特方案。

sentences.en: However, current multi-bit watermarking methods do not allow selective disclosure: verifying any part of the watermark requires revealing the entire embedded message.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的多比特水印方法不允许选择性披露：验证水印的任何部分都需要揭示整个嵌入的消息。

sentences.en: This lack of control leads to unnecessary information exposure and raises privacy concerns.
sentences.zh: 这种控制的缺失导致不必要的信息暴露，并引发隐私问题。

sentences.en: We propose Hierarchical Vocabulary Routing (HeRo), a watermarking framework that enables selective disclosure of embedded metadata.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了分层词汇路由（HeRo），一个能够选择性披露嵌入元数据的水印框架。

sentences.en: The method recursively partitions the vocabulary and distributes watermark information across hierarchical layers, so that different verifiers can decode only the portions of the payload corresponding to their access level.
sentences.zh: 该方法递归地划分词汇表，并将水印信息分布到各分层中，从而使不同的验证者只能解码与其访问级别对应的那部分有效载荷。

sentences.en: We show that the proposed scheme preserves the unbiasedness of the underlying sampling process and thus maintains text quality.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，所提出的方案保持了底层采样过程的无偏性，从而维持了文本质量。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that our framework supports fine-grained access control while achieving high detection accuracy and low latency.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的框架支持细粒度的访问控制，同时实现了较高的检测准确率和较低的延迟。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/xuyangc03/hero-watermark}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在\url{https://github.com/xuyangc03/hero-watermark}获取。

title_en: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索

sentences.en: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel.
sentences.zh: 离散扩散语言模型通过并行地对整个回答进行迭代去噪来生成文本。

sentences.en: At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones.
sentences.zh: 在每一步，它们为每个掩码位置预测暂定的token，将置信的预测提交到输出中，并丢弃不置信的预测。

sentences.en: We show that the discarded tokens are in fact a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation: even low-confidence tokens often surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, enabling retrieval of stronger evidence before the output is finalized.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，被丢弃的token实际上是检索增强生成中一种有用的前视信号：即使低置信度的token也常常在去噪轨迹早期就浮现出显著实体，从而能够在输出定稿之前检索到更有力的证据。

sentences.en: We exploit this through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses these lookahead tokens to guide retrieval during denoising.
sentences.zh: 我们通过面向扩散语言模型的自增强检索（SARDI）来利用这一点，这是一个动态RAG框架，利用这些前视token在去噪过程中引导检索。

sentences.en: SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model.
sentences.zh: SARDI无需训练、与检索器无关，并且适用于任何具备推理能力的离散扩散语言模型。

sentences.en: Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms current training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to $8\times$ higher throughput.
sentences.zh: 在五个多跳问答基准上，SARDI以高达$8\times$的吞吐量超越了当前免训练的扩散式和自回归式检索基线。

title_en: Self-Calibrated Consistency can Fight Back for Adversarial Robustness in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 自校准一致性可回击视觉-语言模型的对抗鲁棒性

sentences.en: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have demonstrated strong zero-shot capabilities across diverse domains, yet remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations that disrupt image-text alignment and compromise reliability.
sentences.zh: CLIP等预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多个领域展现出强大的零样本能力，但仍对破坏图像-文本对齐并危及可靠性的对抗扰动高度脆弱。

sentences.en: Existing defenses typically rely on adversarial fine-tuning with labeled data, limiting their applicability in zero-shot settings.
sentences.zh: 现有的防御通常依赖带标注数据的对抗微调，限制了其在零样本设置中的适用性。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify two key weaknesses of current CLIP adversarial attacks—lack of semantic guidance and vulnerability to view variations—collectively termed semantic and viewpoint fragility.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别出当前CLIP对抗攻击的两个关键弱点——缺乏语义引导和对视角变化的脆弱性——统称为语义脆弱性与视角脆弱性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Self-Calibrated Consistency (SCC), an effective test-time defense.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了自校准一致性（SCC），一种有效的测试时防御。

sentences.en: SCC consists of two complementary modules: Semantic consistency, which leverages soft pseudo-labels from counterattack warm-up and multi-view predictions to regularize cross-modal alignment and separate the target embedding from confusable negatives; and Spatial consistency, aligning perturbed visual predictions via augmented views to stabilize inference under adversarial perturbations.
sentences.zh: SCC由两个互补的模块组成：语义一致性，利用来自反攻预热和多视角预测的软伪标签来正则化跨模态对齐，并将目标嵌入与易混淆的负例分开；以及空间一致性，通过增广视角对齐受扰动的视觉预测，以在对抗扰动下稳定推理。

sentences.en: Together, these modules form a plug-and-play inference strategy.
sentences.zh: 这两个模块共同构成一种即插即用的推理策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 22 benchmarks under diverse attack settings show that SCC consistently improves the zero-shot robustness of CLIP while maintaining accuracy, and can be seamlessly integrated with other VLMs for further gains.
sentences.zh: 在22个基准、多种攻击设置下的大量实验表明，SCC在保持准确率的同时持续提升CLIP的零样本鲁棒性，并可无缝集成到其他VLM中获得进一步增益。

sentences.en: These findings highlight the great potential of establishing an adversarially robust paradigm from CLIP, with implications extending to broader VLMs such as BioMedCLIP.
sentences.zh: 这些发现凸显了从CLIP建立对抗鲁棒范式的巨大潜力，其影响可扩展到BioMedCLIP等更广泛的VLM。

title_en: Self-Captioning Multimodal Interaction Tuning: Amplifying Exploitable Redundancies for Robust Vision Language Models
title_zh: 自描述多模态交互微调：为稳健的视觉语言模型放大可利用冗余

sentences.en: Current vision language models face hallucination and robustness issues against ambiguous or corrupted modalities.
sentences.zh: 当前的视觉语言模型在面对模糊或受损模态时存在幻觉和鲁棒性问题。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that these issues can be addressed by exploiting the shared information between modalities to compensate for the impaired one.
sentences.zh: 我们假设这些问题可以通过利用模态之间的共享信息来补偿受损的模态而得到解决。

sentences.en: To this end, we analyze multimodal interactions -- redundant (shared), unique (exclusive), and synergistic (emergent) task-relevant information provided by the modalities -- to determine their impacts on model reliability.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们分析了多模态交互——模态提供的冗余（共享）、独特（专属）和协同（涌现）的任务相关信息——以确定它们对模型可靠性的影响。

sentences.en: Specifically, amplifying redundant interactions would increase this exploitable shared information to resolve these issues; yet, modern instruction datasets often eliminate redundancies to prioritize visual grounding.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，放大冗余交互会增加这种可利用的共享信息，从而解决这些问题；然而，现代指令数据集往往消除冗余以优先进行视觉基础对齐。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap through a self-captioning workflow featuring a \textsc{Multimodal Interaction Gate}: a mechanism to convert unique interactions into redundant interactions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个具有\textsc{Multimodal Interaction Gate}（多模态交互门）的自描述流程来弥合这一差距：该机制将独特交互转换为冗余交互。

sentences.en: Our findings suggest that increasing redundancy can reduce visual induced errors by 38.3\% and improve consistency by 16.8\%.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，增加冗余可将视觉引发的错误减少38.3\%，并将一致性提升16.8\%。

title_en: Self-correcting for Debiasing Large Language Models
title_zh: 用于大语言模型去偏的自校正

sentences.en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, inherent social biases often cascade throughout the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process, leading to continuous "Bias Propagation".
sentences.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）展现出卓越的推理能力，但固有的社会偏见往往在思维链（CoT）过程中级联传播，导致持续的“偏见传播”。

sentences.en: Existing debiasing methods primarily focus on static constraints or external interventions, failing to identify and interrupt this propagation once triggered.
sentences.zh: 现有的去偏方法主要聚焦于静态约束或外部干预，而无法在传播触发后识别并中断它。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Debias, a progressive framework designed to instill intrinsic self-correction capabilities.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们引入了Self-Debias，一个旨在灌输内在自校正能力的渐进式框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we reformulate the debiasing process as a strategic resource redistribution problem, treating the model's output probability mass as a limited resource to be reallocated from biased heuristics to unbiased reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将去偏过程重新表述为一个战略性资源再分配问题，将模型的输出概率质量视为一种有限资源，需要从有偏启发式重新分配到无偏推理路径。

sentences.en: Unlike standard preference optimization which applies broad penalties, Self-Debias employs a fine-grained trajectory-level objective subject to dynamic debiasing constraints.
sentences.zh: 与施加宽泛惩罚的标准偏好优化不同，Self-Debias采用了受动态去偏约束约束的细粒度轨迹级目标。

sentences.en: This enables the model to selectively revise biased reasoning suffixes while preserving valid contextual prefixes.
sentences.zh: 这使得模型能够选择性地修正有偏的推理后缀，同时保留有效的上下文前缀。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we integrate an online self-improvement mechanism utilizing consistency filtering to autonomously synthesize supervision signals.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们整合了一个利用一致性过滤的在线自我改进机制，以自主地合成监督信号。

sentences.en: With merely 20k annotated samples, Self-Debias activates efficient self-correction, achieving superior debiasing performance while preserving general reasoning capabilities without continuous external oversight.
sentences.zh: 仅用2万个标注样本，Self-Debias即能激活高效的自我校正，在保持一般推理能力的同时取得卓越的去偏性能，且无需持续的外部监督。

title_en: Self-CriTeach: LLM Self-Teaching and Self-Critiquing for Improving Robotic Planning via Automated Domain Generation
title_zh: Self-CriTeach：通过自动域生成实现LLM自教与自评以改进机器人规划

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong promise for robotic task planning, particularly through automatic planning domain generation.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）近来在机器人任务规划方面展现出巨大潜力，尤其是通过自动规划域生成。

sentences.en: However, prior approaches largely treat generated planning domains as planning utilities, which are brittle under imperfect logical states and perception noise, overlooking their potential as scalable sources of reasoning supervision and structured reward signals.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前的方法在很大程度上将生成的规划域视为规划工具，这些域在逻辑状态不完善和感知噪声下较为脆弱，忽视了它们作为可扩展推理监督来源和结构化奖励信号的潜力。

sentences.en: At the same time, reasoning LLMs depend on chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision that is expensive to collect for robotic tasks, and reinforcement learning (RL) faces challenges on reward engineering.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，推理型LLM依赖的思维链（CoT）监督对机器人任务而言收集成本高昂，而强化学习（RL）则面临奖励工程方面的挑战。

sentences.en: We propose Self-CriTeach, an LLM self-teaching and self-critiquing framework in which an LLM autonomously generates symbolic planning domains that serve a dual role: (i) enabling large-scale generation of robotic planning problem–plan pairs, and (ii) providing structured reward functions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了Self-CriTeach，一个LLM自教与自评框架，其中LLM自主生成符号规划域，这些域发挥双重作用：（i）支持大规模生成机器人规划问题-规划对，以及（ii）提供结构化的奖励函数。

sentences.en: First, the self-written domains enable large-scale generation of symbolic task plans, which are automatically transformed into extended CoT trajectories for supervised fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 首先，自编写的域支持大规模生成符号任务规划，这些规划被自动转化为扩展的CoT轨迹用于监督微调。

sentences.en: Second, the self-written domains are reused as structured reward functions, providing dense feedback for reinforcement learning without manual reward engineering.
sentences.zh: 其次，自编写的域被复用为结构化奖励函数，为强化学习提供密集反馈，而无需手动奖励工程。

sentences.en: This unified training pipeline yields a planning-enhanced LLM with higher planning success rates, stronger cross-task generalization, reduced inference cost, and resistance to imperfect logical states.
sentences.zh: 这一统一的训练流程产生了一个规划增强型LLM，具有更高的规划成功率、更强的跨任务泛化能力、更低的推理成本，以及对不完善逻辑状态的鲁棒性。

title_en: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
title_zh: 自蒸馏实现持续学习

sentences.en: Continual learning, enabling models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities, remains a fundamental challenge for foundation models.
sentences.zh: 持续学习使模型能够获取新技能和新知识而不退化已有能力，对于基础模型而言仍是一个基本挑战。

sentences.en: While on-policy reinforcement learning can reduce forgetting, it requires explicit reward functions that are often unavailable.
sentences.zh: 虽然在线（on-policy）强化学习可以减少遗忘，但它需要显式的奖励函数，而这些函数往往不可用。

sentences.en: Learning from expert demonstrations, the primary alternative, is dominated by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which is inherently off-policy.
sentences.zh: 从专家示范中学习这一主要替代方案，通常由监督微调（SFT）主导，而SFT本质上是离线（off-policy)的。

sentences.en: We introduce Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), a simple method that enables on-policy learning directly from demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了自蒸馏微调（SDFT），一种直接从示范实现在线学习的简单方法。

sentences.en: SDFT leverages in-context learning by using a demonstration-conditioned model as its own teacher, generating on-policy training signals that preserve prior capabilities while acquiring new skills.
sentences.zh: SDFT利用上下文学习，将示范条件模型作为其自身的教师，生成在线的训练信号，从而在获取新技能的同时保留先前的能力。

sentences.en: Across skill learning and knowledge acquisition tasks, SDFT consistently outperforms SFT, achieving higher new-task accuracy while substantially reducing catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 在技能学习和知识获取任务中，SDFT始终优于SFT，在取得更高新任务准确率的同时大幅减少灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: In sequential learning experiments, SDFT enables a single model to accumulate multiple skills over time without performance regression, establishing on-policy distillation as a practical path to continual learning from demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 在序列学习实验中，SDFT使单一模型能够随时间累积多种技能而无性能回退，确立了在线蒸馏作为从示范实现持续学习的实用路径。

title_en: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
title_zh: 自蒸馏推理器：面向大语言模型的在线自蒸馏

sentences.en: Knowledge distillation improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by compressing the knowledge of a teacher LLM to train smaller LLMs.
sentences.zh: 知识蒸馏通过压缩教师LLM的知识来训练更小的LLM，从而改进大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。

sentences.en: On-policy distillation advances this approach by having the student sample its own trajectories while a teacher LLM provides dense token-level supervision, addressing the distribution mismatch between training and inference in off-policy distillation methods.
sentences.zh: 在线蒸馏进一步发展了这种方法，让学生模型自行采样轨迹，同时由教师LLM提供密集的token级监督，解决了离线蒸馏方法中训练与推理之间的分布失配问题。

sentences.en: However, on-policy distillation typically requires a separate, often larger, teacher LLM and does not explicitly leverage ground-truth solutions available in reasoning datasets.
sentences.zh: 然而，在线蒸馏通常需要一个独立的、通常更大的教师LLM，并且没有显式利用推理数据集中可用的真实解。

sentences.en: Inspired by the intuition that a sufficiently capable LLM can rationalize external privileged reasoning traces and teach its weaker self, we introduce On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a learning algorithm where a single LLM acts as both teacher and student with different contexts.
sentences.zh: 受到“一个能力足够强的LLM能够合理化外部特权推理轨迹并教导其较弱的自身”这一直觉的启发，我们引入了在线自蒸馏（OPSD），一种让单个LLM在不同上下文中同时扮演教师和学生角色的学习算法。

sentences.en: The teacher policy conditions on privileged information  while the student policy sees only the question; training minimizes the per-token divergence between these distributions over the student's own rollouts.
sentences.zh: 教师策略以特权信息为条件，而学生策略只看到问题本身；训练在学生的自身采样轨迹上最小化这两个分布之间的逐token散度。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving superior token efficiency compared to reinforcement learning methods and better performance over off-policy distillation methods.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个数学推理基准上证明了我们方法的有效性，相比强化学习方法取得了更优的token效率，相比离线蒸馏方法取得了更好的性能。

title_en: Self-evolving LLM agents with in-distribution Optimization
title_zh: 具有分布内优化的自进化LLM智能体

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful controllers for interactive agents in complex environments, yet training them to perform reliable long-horizon decision making remains a fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）近来已成为复杂环境中交互智能体的强大控制器，然而训练它们在长时间跨度内进行可靠决策仍然是一个基本挑战。

sentences.en: A key difficulty lies in credit assignment: agents often receive delayed rewards only at the end of episodes.
sentences.zh: 一个关键难点在于信用分配：智能体往往只在回合结束时才收到延迟的奖励。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Q-Evolve, a self-evolving framework for LLM agents that unifies automatic process-reward labeling and policy learning within a principled in-distribution reinforcement learning paradigm.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了Q-Evolve，一个在原则上一致的分布内强化学习范式中统一自动过程奖励标注与策略学习的LLM智能体自进化框架。

sentences.en: In each evolving iteration, our method learns an in-distribution critic from a hybrid off-policy dataset that combines expert demonstrations with agent-generated trajectories, stabilizing Bellman backups in sparse-reward settings via a weighted Implicit Q-Learning objective.
sentences.zh: 在每一轮进化迭代中，我们的方法从结合专家示范与智能体生成轨迹的混合离线数据集中学习一个分布内评论家，通过加权隐式Q学习目标在稀疏奖励设置下稳定Bellman备份。

sentences.en: The learned value function is then used to derive step-wise process rewards through advantage estimation, enabling dense and reliable supervision without environment backtracking or human annotation.
sentences.zh: 然后利用学习到的价值函数通过优势估计推导出逐步过程奖励，从而在无需环境回溯或人工标注的情况下提供密集且可靠的监督。

sentences.en: Leveraging these signals, we perform behavior-proximal policy optimization that evolves the agent over the data used for process reward labeling, allowing iterative self-improvement without exacerbating distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 借助这些信号，我们执行行为邻近的策略优化，使智能体在用于过程奖励标注的数据上进化，从而在没有加剧分布偏移的情况下实现迭代式自我改进。

sentences.en: We evaluate our method on AlfWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, showing Q-Evolve outperforms strong baselines in sample efficiency, robustness, and overall task performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在AlfWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上评估了我们的方法，表明Q-Evolve在样本效率、鲁棒性和整体任务性能方面优于强基线。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that stable agent self-evolution is achievable through the co-evolution of process-level supervision and policy, both grounded within a shared in-distribution learning loop.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，通过过程级监督与策略的共同进化（两者都植根于同一个共享的分布内学习循环），可以实现稳定的智能体自进化。

title_en: Self-Guidance: Enhancing Neural Codecs via Decoder Manifold Alignment
title_zh: 自引导：通过解码器流形对齐增强神经编解码器

sentences.en: Neural speech codecs based on Vector-Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAEs) are core audio tokenizers for speech LLMs, yet their reconstruction fidelity is bottlenecked by quantization error.
sentences.zh: 基于向量量化VAE（VQ-VAE）的神经语音编解码器是语音LLM的核心音频tokenizer，但其重建保真度受到量化误差的瓶颈限制。

sentences.en: Modifying the quantizer or increasing model capacity are common fixes, but they complicate downstream language modeling.
sentences.zh: 修改量化器或增加模型容量是常见的修复手段，但会使下游语言建模变得复杂。

sentences.en: Our core idea is to align the decoder's internal feature manifolds when processing both the quantized tokens and their original continuous embeddings, using a lightweight feature-mapping loss.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心思想是使用一个轻量级特征映射损失，使解码器在处理量化token及其原始连续嵌入时对齐其内部特征流形。

sentences.en: This requires minimal training overhead and no inference-time changes.
sentences.zh: 这要求极小的训练开销，且无需推理时的任何改动。

sentences.en: Applied to XCodec2, self-guidance improves all reconstruction metrics, achieving state-of-the-art low-bitrate performance.
sentences.zh: 应用于XCodec2时，自引导改善了所有重建指标，实现了最先进的低比特率性能。

sentences.en: Notably, it enables a 4× codebook reduction without fidelity loss, which downstream TTS experiments show significantly improves LLM-based synthesis by simplifying the token modeling space.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，它能够在不损失保真度的情况下实现4倍码本缩减，下游TTS实验表明，这通过简化token建模空间显著改进了基于LLM的合成。

sentences.en: Multiple statistical observations and visualizations corroborate the enhanced internal manifold alignment in the decoder.
sentences.zh: 多项统计观测和可视化验证了解码器内部流形对齐的增强。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments confirm its generality across various inductive biases.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证实了其跨各种归纳偏置的通用性。

sentences.en: Self-guidance thus establishes an efficient, broadly applicable method for high-fidelity neural audio coding.
sentences.zh: 因此，自引导为高保真神经音频编码确立了一种高效且广泛适用的方法。

title_en: Self-Prompting Diffusion Transformer for Open-Vocabulary Scene Text Edit via In-Context Learning
title_zh: 通过上下文学习的开放词汇场景文本编辑自提示扩散Transformer

sentences.en: Scene text editing aims to modify text in a target region of an image while preserving its background style and texture.
sentences.zh: 场景文本编辑旨在修改图像目标区域中的文本，同时保留其背景风格和纹理。

sentences.en: Existing methods rely solely on image background information while neglecting the visual details of target regions, which discards stylistic features in the original text and essentially degrades the task to text rendering.
sentences.zh: 现有方法仅依赖图像背景信息而忽略目标区域的视觉细节，这会丢弃原始文本中的风格特征，本质上将任务退化为文本渲染。

sentences.en: Moreover, the conditions imposed by pre-trained glyph encoder limit the scope of editable text.
sentences.zh: 此外，预训练字形编码器所施加的条件限制了可编辑文本的范围。

sentences.en: To address these issues, this paper proposes a self-prompting scene text editing method, which constructs style and glyph prompts directly from the original image without additional style or glyph encoders.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种自提示场景文本编辑方法，直接从原始图像构建风格和字形提示，而无需额外的风格或字形编码器。

sentences.en: We employ a two-stage training strategy, where the diffusion transformer is first trained on large-scale self-supervised datasets and subsequently refined with a small set of paired images.
sentences.zh: 我们采用两阶段训练策略，扩散Transformer首先在大规模自监督数据集上训练，随后用一小部分配对图像进行精调。

sentences.en: By leveraging the in-context learning capability of FLUX-Fill, it achieves open-vocabulary and style-consistent text editing.
sentences.zh: 通过利用FLUX-Fill的上下文学习能力，它实现了开放词汇且风格一致的文本编辑。

sentences.en: Experimental results on various languages demonstrate that our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance in both text accuracy and style consistency.
sentences.zh: 在多种语言上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在文本准确性和风格一致性方面均达到了最先进的性能。

authors.name: Ting Liu
authors.institution: Beijing Meitu Home Technology Co., Ltd.

title_en: Self-Prophetic Decoding to Unlock Visual Search in LVLMs
title_zh: 自预言解码以解锁LVLM中的视觉搜索

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are rapidly evolving toward true multimodal reasoning, with visual search representing a concrete instantiation of the thinking-with-images paradigm.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）正快速朝向真正的多模态推理演进，视觉搜索正是“与图像一起思考”范式的具体落地。

sentences.en: However, LVLM visual search faces two key challenges: incompatibility among intrinsic capabilities after post-training, and interference in long multi-step reasoning contexts.
sentences.zh: 然而，LVLM视觉搜索面临两个关键挑战：后训练后内在能力之间的不相容，以及长多步推理上下文中的干扰。

sentences.en: To address these, we identify two novel insights.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们识别出两个新颖的洞察。

sentences.en: First, self-regulation between pre- and post-training LVLMs leverages the intrinsic single-step capabilities of the pre-training model to mitigate capability deterioration and long-context interference.
sentences.zh: 首先，前后训练LVLM之间的自调节利用预训练模型内在的单步能力，以缓解能力退化与长上下文干扰。

sentences.en: Second, probability-based prophetic sampling, replacing naive prompting, provides a probabilistic interface where the pre-training model acts as a prophet and the post-training model selectively accepts prophetic tokens under its output distribution, preserving coherent multi-step reasoning.
sentences.zh: 其次，基于概率的预言采样取代朴素的提示方式，提供了一个概率接口：预训练模型扮演预言者角色，而后训练模型在其输出分布下选择性地接受预言token，从而保持连贯的多步推理。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we introduce SeProD, a self-prophetic decoding framework that leverages intrinsic single-step capabilities to enable coherent multi-step reasoning in a training-free, plug-and-play manner.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞察，我们引入了SeProD，一个自预言解码框架，以无需训练、即插即用的方式利用内在单步能力实现连贯的多步推理。

sentences.en: Experiments show that SeProD consistently improves multiple visual-search LVLMs across all 12 splits of 4 visual search benchmarks, as well as across general VQA benchmarks, without added computational overhead, thanks to its parallel prophetic acceptance mechanism.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，凭借其并行的预言接受机制，SeProD在4个视觉搜索基准的全部12个划分以及通用VQA基准上，持续提升了多个视觉搜索LVLM的性能，且未增加计算开销。

title_en: Self-Refining Video Sampling
title_zh: 自精化视频采样

sentences.en: Modern video generators still struggle with complex physical dynamics, often falling short of physical realism.
sentences.zh: 现代视频生成器在复杂物理动力学方面仍存在困难，往往达不到物理真实感。

sentences.en: Existing approaches address this using external verifiers or additional training on augmented data, which is computationally expensive and still limited in capturing fine-grained motion.
sentences.zh: 现有方法借助外部验证器或对增广数据的额外训练来解决这一问题，但这些方法计算开销大，且在捕捉细粒度运动方面仍存在局限。

sentences.en: In this work, we present self-refining video sampling, a simple method that uses a pre-trained video generator trained on large-scale datasets as its own self-refiner.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了自精化视频采样，一种简单的方法，利用在大型数据集上训练好的预训练视频生成器作为其自身的精化器。

sentences.en: By interpreting the generator as a denoising autoencoder, we enable iterative inner-loop refinement at inference time without any external verifier or additional training.
sentences.zh: 通过将生成器解释为去噪自编码器，我们能够在推理时不借助任何外部验证器或额外训练实现迭代式内环精化。

sentences.en: We further introduce an uncertainty-aware refinement strategy that selectively refines regions based on self-consistency, which prevents artifacts caused by over-refinement.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入了一种不确定性感知的精化策略，基于自一致性选择性地精化区域，从而防止过度精化带来的人工痕迹。

sentences.en: Experiments on state-of-the-art video generators demonstrate significant improvements in motion coherence and physics alignment, achieving over 70% human preference compared to the default sampler and guidance-based sampler.
sentences.zh: 在最先进的视频生成器上的实验表明，在运动连贯性和物理对齐方面取得了显著改进，相比默认采样器和基于引导的采样器，赢得了超过70%的人类偏好。

title_en: Self-Soupervision: Cooking Model Soups without Labels
title_zh: 自监督食谱法：无需标签烹制模型浓汤

sentences.en: Model soups are strange and strangely effective combinations of parameters.
sentences.zh: 模型浓汤是一种奇怪却异常有效的参数组合方式。

sentences.en: They take a model (the stock), fine-tune it into multiple models (the ingredients), and then mix their parameters back into one model (the soup) to improve predictions.
sentences.zh: 它们将一个模型（高汤）微调成多个模型（配料），然后将其参数混合回一个模型（浓汤）中以改进预测。

sentences.en: While all known soups require supervised learning, and optimize the same loss on labeled data, our recipes for Self-Soupervision generalize soups to self-supervised learning (SSL).
sentences.zh: 虽然所有已知的汤都依赖于监督学习，并在标注数据上优化相同的损失，但我们的自监督食谱法（Self-Soupervision）将制作浓汤推广到了自监督学习（SSL）。

sentences.en: Our Self-Souping lets us flavor ingredients on new data sources, e.g. from unlabeled data from a task for transfer or from a shift for robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们的自我烹汤法让我们能够在新的数据来源上给配料调味，例如使用任务中无标签数据用于迁移，或使用分布偏移数据用于鲁棒性。

sentences.en: We show that Self-Souping on corrupted test data, then fine-tuning back on uncorrupted train data, boosts robustness by +3.5% (ImageNet-C) and +7% (LAION-C).
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在受污染的测试数据上进行自我烹汤，再在未受污染的训练数据上微调回来，可提升鲁棒性+3.5%（ImageNet-C）和+7%（LAION-C）。

sentences.en: Self-Soupervision also unlocks countless SSL algorithms to cook the diverse ingredients needed for more robust soups.
sentences.zh: 自监督食谱法还为烹制更鲁棒浓汤所需的多样配料解锁了无数SSL算法。

sentences.en: We show for the first time that ingredients can differ in their SSL hyperparameters---and more surprisingly, in their SSL algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们首次表明，配料可以在其SSL超参数上有所不同——更令人惊讶的是，在其SSL算法上也可以不同。

sentences.en: We cook soups of MAE, MoCoV3, and MMCR ingredients that are more accurate than any one single SSL ingredient.
sentences.zh: 我们烹制了MAE、MoCoV3和MMCR配料的浓汤，其准确率高于任何单一SSL配料。

title_en: Self-Supervised Dynamical System Representations for Physiological Time-Series
title_zh: 用于生理时序的自监督动力系统表征

sentences.en: Self-supervised learning for physiological time-series aims to captures the identity of the underlying dynamical process while filtering irrelevant noise.
sentences.zh: 生理时序的自监督学习旨在捕捉底层动力过程的特征，同时滤除无关噪声。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches may obscure the clinical semantics important for downstream transferability.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法可能模糊对下游可迁移性至关重要的临床语义。

sentences.en: Weakly constrained pretext tasks (i.e. contrastive learning, MAE) may incorrectly ignore the underlying dynamical structure, while structurally constrained models (i.e. SVAEs) are unable to selectively filter sample-specific noise.
sentences.zh: 弱约束的预训练任务（如对比学习、MAE）可能错误地忽略底层动力结构，而结构化约束模型（如SVAE）则无法选择性地过滤样本特定噪声。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose ${\bf PULSE}$, a novel pretraining objective that simultaneously preserves dynamical relationships important to physiological time-series while selectively removing irrelevant noise.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了${\bf PULSE}$，一种新颖的预训练目标，同时保留对生理时序重要的动力关系，并选择性地去除无关噪声。

sentences.en: We achieve this by formulating a dynamical systems model to identify transferable and non-transferable information between time-series windows, and target the former through a novel cross-reconstruction objective.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构建一个动力系统模型来识别时序窗口之间可迁移与不可迁移的信息，并通过一种新颖的跨重建目标聚焦于前者。

sentences.en: We establish theory that provides conditions for when transferrable information is recovered, and empirically validate it through synthetic experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了可为可迁移信息何时被恢复提供条件的理论，并通过合成实验对其进行了实证验证。

sentences.en: On several real-world datasets, PULSE effectively distinguishes clinical semantic classes, increases label efficiency, and improves transfer learning performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实数据集上，PULSE有效地区分临床语义类别，提高了标签效率，并改善了迁移学习性能。

title_en: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
title_zh: 用于可扩展多模态合成的自监督流匹配

sentences.en: Strong semantic representations improve the convergence and generation quality of diffusion and flow models.
sentences.zh: 强的语义表征能改善扩散模型和流模型的收敛性与生成质量。

sentences.en: Existing approaches largely rely on external models, which require separate training, operate on misaligned objectives, and exhibit unexpected scaling behavior.
sentences.zh: 现有方法在很大程度上依赖外部模型，这些模型需要单独训练、在不对齐的目标上运行，并表现出意想不到的扩展行为。

sentences.en: We argue that this dependence arises from the model's training objective, which poses a denoising task with little incentive to learn semantic representations.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这种依赖性源于模型的训练目标，该目标构设了一个去噪任务，几乎没有学习语义表征的动机。

sentences.en: We introduce *Self-Flow*: a self-supervised flow matching paradigm that integrates representation learning within the generative framework.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了*Self-Flow*：一种自监督流匹配范式，将表征学习整合到生成框架内部。

sentences.en: Our key mechanism, *Dual-Timestep Scheduling*, applies heterogeneous noise levels across tokens, creating an information asymmetry that forces the model to infer missing information from corrupted inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键机制*Dual-Timestep Scheduling*（双时间步调度）在token间施加异构噪声水平，创造出信息不对称，迫使模型从受损输入中推断缺失信息。

sentences.en: This drives learning strong representations alongside generative capabilities without external supervision.
sentences.zh: 这在不依赖外部监督的情况下，驱动模型在生成能力之外学习强表征。

sentences.en: Our method generalizes across modalities and enables multi-modal training while following expected scaling laws, achieving superior image, video, and audio generation.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法跨模态泛化，并在遵循预期扩展定律的同时支持多模态训练，实现了优越的图像、视频和音频生成。

title_en: Self-supervised Hierarchical Visual Reasoning with World Model
title_zh: 具有世界模型的自监督分层视觉推理

sentences.en: 3D open-world environments with adversarial opponents remain a core challenge for reinforcement learning due to their vast state spaces.
sentences.zh: 具有对抗对手的3D开放世界环境由于其庞大的状态空间，仍是强化学习面临的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Effective reasoning representations are essential in such settings.
sentences.zh: 在这样的环境中，有效的推理表征至关重要。

sentences.en: While existing self-supervised visual foresight reasoning approaches often suffer from multi-step error accumulation, many recent studies resort to injecting domain-specific knowledge for more stable guidance.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的自监督视觉前瞻推理方法常常受累于多步误差累积，但许多近期的研究转而注入特定领域知识以提供更稳定的引导。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that the photorealistic fidelity of visual reasoning representations is secondary; what truly matters is providing informative, task-relevant signals.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键见解是，视觉推理表征的逼真度是次要的；真正重要的是提供信息丰富、与任务相关的信号。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose ResDreamer, a hierarchical world model in which each higher-level layer is trained to reconstruct the residuals of the layer below.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了ResDreamer，一个分层世界模型，其中每一更高层都被训练来重建其下层的残差。

sentences.en: This design enables progressive abstraction of increasingly sophisticated world dynamics and fosters the emergence of richer latent representations.
sentences.zh: 这一设计能够渐进抽象日益复杂的动力学，并促进更丰富潜在表征的涌现。

sentences.en: Drawing inspiration from the “Bitter Lesson,” ResDreamer trains its reasoning representations in a purely self-supervised manner.
sentences.zh: 受“苦学教训”（Bitter Lesson）的启发，ResDreamer以纯自监督方式训练其推理表征。

sentences.en: The higher-level residual representations are used to modulate lower-level predictions, allowing the world model to scale effectively with only linearly increasing cross-layer communication costs.
sentences.zh: 更高层的残差表征被用来调制下层的预测，使世界模型能够以仅线性增长的跨层通信成本高效扩展。

sentences.en: Experiments show that ResDreamer achieves state-of-the-art sample efficiency and parameter efficiency.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，ResDreamer达到了最先进的样本效率和参数效率。

sentences.en: This scalable hierarchical visual foresight reasoning architecture paves the way for more capable online RL agents in open-ended, dynamic environments.
sentences.zh: 这一可扩展的分层视觉前瞻推理架构，为在开放、动态环境中更具能力的在线RL智能体铺平了道路。

title_en: Self-Supervised Learning as Discrete Communication
title_zh: 将自监督学习视为离散通信

sentences.en: Most self-supervised learning (SSL) methods learn continuous visual representations by aligning different views of the same input, offering limited control over how information is structured across representation dimensions.
sentences.zh: 大多数自监督学习（SSL）方法通过对齐同一输入的不同视角来学习连续视觉表征，对信息如何跨表征维度组织所提供的控制有限。

sentences.en: In this work, we frame visual self-supervised learning as a discrete communication process between a teacher and a student network, where semantic information is transmitted through a fixed-capacity binary channel.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们将视觉自监督学习框定为教师网络与学生网络之间的离散通信过程，其中语义信息通过一个固定容量的二进制信道传输。

sentences.en: Rather than aligning continuous features, the student predicts multi-label binary messages produced by the teacher.
sentences.zh: 学生并非对齐连续特征，而是预测教师产生的多标签二进制消息。

sentences.en: Discrete agreement is enforced through an element-wise binary cross-entropy objective, while a coding-rate regularization term encourages effective utilization of the constrained channel, promoting structured representations.
sentences.zh: 通过逐元素的二元交叉熵目标强制执行离散一致性，而编码率正则化项则鼓励有效利用受限信道，从而促进结构化表征的形成。

sentences.en: We further show that periodically reinitializing the projection head strengthens this effect by encouraging embeddings that remain predictive across multiple discrete encodings.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，周期性地重新初始化投影头会强化这一效果，因为这会鼓励嵌入在多种离散编码上仍保持可预测性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over continuous agreement baselines on image classification, retrieval, and dense visual prediction tasks, as well as under domain shift through self-supervised adaptation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，相比连续一致性基线，我们的方法在图像分类、检索和密集视觉预测任务上，以及在通过自监督适应的域偏移情形下，均带来一致的改进。

sentences.en: Beyond backbone representations, we analyze the learned binary codes and show that they form a compact and informative discrete language, capturing semantic factors reusable across classes.
sentences.zh: 除骨干表征外，我们分析了学到的二进制编码，表明它们形成了一种紧凑且信息丰富的离散语言，捕捉了可跨类复用的语义因素。

title_en: Self-Supervised Weight Templates for Scalable Vision Model Initialization
title_zh: 用于可扩展视觉模型初始化的自监督权重模板

sentences.en: The increasing scale and complexity of modern model parameters underscore the importance of pre-trained models.
sentences.zh: 现代模型参数规模与复杂性的日益增长，凸显了预训练模型的重要性。

sentences.en: However, deployment often demands architectures of varying sizes, exposing limitations of conventional pre-training and fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 然而，部署往往要求各种尺寸的架构，这暴露了传统预训练与微调的局限性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose SWEET, a self-supervised framework that performs constraint-based pre-training to enable scalable initialization in vision tasks.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了SWEET，一个执行基于约束的预训练、以在视觉任务中实现可扩展初始化的自监督框架。

sentences.en: Instead of pre-training a fixed-size model, we learn a shared weight template and size-specific weight scalers under Tucker-based factorization, which promotes modularity and supports flexible adaptation to architectures with varying depths and widths.
sentences.zh: 我们并非预训练一个固定大小的模型，而是在基于Tucker分解下学习一个共享权重模板和尺寸特定的权重缩放器，这促进了模块化，并支持灵活适配各种深度和宽度的架构。

sentences.en: Target models are subsequently initialized by composing and reweighting the template through lightweight weight scalers, whose parameters can be efficiently learned from minimal training data.
sentences.zh: 目标模型随后通过轻量级权重缩放器组合并重新加权模板来初始化，这些缩放器的参数可以从极少量的训练数据中高效学习。

sentences.en: To further enhance flexibility in width expansion, we introduce width-wise stochastic scaling, which regularizes the template along width-related dimensions and encourages robust, width-invariant representations for improved cross-width generalization.
sentences.zh: 为进一步增强宽度扩展的灵活性，我们引入了宽度维随机缩放，它在宽度相关维度上对模板进行正则化，并鼓励稳健、宽度不变的表示以改进跨宽度泛化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on classification, detection, segmentation and generation tasks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of SWEET for initializing variable-sized vision models.
sentences.zh: 在分类、检测、分割和生成任务上的大量实验表明，SWEET在初始化变尺寸视觉模型方面达到了最先进的性能。

title_en: SelfJudge: Faster Speculative Decoding via Self-Supervised Judge Verification
title_zh: SelfJudge：通过自监督评判验证实现更快的投机解码

sentences.en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by verifying candidate tokens from a draft model against a larger target model.
sentences.zh: 投机解码通过对照更大的目标模型验证草稿模型产生的候选token来加速LLM推理。

sentences.en: Recent "judge'' decoding boosts this process by relaxing verification criteria by accepting draft tokens that may exhibit minor discrepancies from target model output, but existing methods are restricted by their reliance on human annotations or tasks with verifiable ground truths, limiting generalizability across diverse NLP tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期的“评判”（judge）解码通过放宽验证标准来增强这一过程，即接受与目标模型输出可能存在微小差异的草稿token，但现有方法受制于对人工标注或具有可验证真值任务的依赖，限制了其在多种NLP任务上的泛化能力。

sentences.en: We propose SelfJudge, which trains judge verifiers via self-supervision of the target model.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SelfJudge，通过目标模型的自监督来训练评判验证器。

sentences.en: Our method measures semantic preservation by assessing whether token-substituted responses preserve the meaning of original responses, enabling automatic verifier training across diverse NLP tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过评估token替换后的回答是否保持原始回答的含义来度量语义保持，从而能够在多种NLP任务上实现验证器的自动训练。

sentences.en: Our experiments show SelfJudge achieves superior inference-accuracy trade-offs than judge decoding baselines, offering a broadly applicable solution for faster LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，SelfJudge比评判解码基线取得了更优的推理-精度权衡，为更快的LLM推理提供了一种广泛适用的解决方案。

title_en: Selling Data as a Digital Good with Scaling Valuations
title_zh: 以扩展估值将数据作为数字商品出售

sentences.en: We study mechanism design for selling data as a digital good when the value derived from training AI models follows a scaling law.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在训练AI模型所获价值服从扩展定律时，将数据作为数字商品出售的机制设计。

sentences.en: The seller faces a linear cost when producing data, while the buyers benefit from additional data with diminishing returns as data volume increases.
sentences.zh: 卖家在生产数据时面临线性成本，而买家则随着数据量的增加从额外数据中获得递减的边际收益。

sentences.en: This departs from classical auction models by allowing allocations to be continuous quantities of data rather than binary outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这与经典拍卖模型不同，它允许分配是数据的连续数量而非二元结果。

sentences.en: We first analyze an offline setting in which all buyer types are realized simultaneously, characterizing profit-optimal mechanisms and showing how virtual-value methods extend to continuous data allocations.
sentences.zh: 我们首先分析所有买家类型同时实现的离线设置，刻画了利润最优机制，并展示了虚拟价值方法如何扩展到连续数据分配。

sentences.en: We then consider an online setting with sequential arrivals, where production decisions must be made under demand uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 然后我们考虑具有顺序到达的在线设置，其中生产决策必须在需求不确定的情况下做出。

sentences.en: We show that myopic allocation and fixed production plans can be arbitrarily suboptimal, whereas a simple two-stage algorithm that combines upfront production with adaptive expansion achieves a constant-factor approximation to the offline optimum.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，短视分配与固定生产计划可能任意次优，而一个结合前期生产与自适应扩张的简单两阶段算法可实现离线最优的常数因子近似。

sentences.en: Finally, we study bilateral data trading under asymmetric information, where both the buyer’s value and the seller’s cost are private.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们研究信息不对称下的双边数据交易，其中买方的价值和卖方的成本都是私人的。

sentences.en: Although the optimal truthful mechanism has a complex structure, we show that simple and implementable mechanisms recover a constant fraction of the first-best gain-from-trade.
sentences.zh: 虽然最优诚实机制具有复杂结构，但我们表明简单且可实施的机制可恢复最优交易收益的常数比例。

sentences.en: Overall, our results highlight how scaling laws introduce new algorithmic trade-offs in market design and provide performance guarantees for data markets under uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果凸显了扩展定律如何在市场设计中引入新的算法权衡，并为不确定性下的数据市场提供性能保证。

title_en: SEM-CTRL: Semantically Controlled Decoding
title_zh: SEM-CTRL：语义受控解码

sentences.en: Ensuring both syntactic and semantic correctness in Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remains a significant challenge, despite being critical for real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 确保大语言模型（LLM）输出的句法和语义正确性仍然是一个重大挑战，尽管这对现实部署至关重要。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$, a unified approach that allows for enforcing rich context-sensitive constraints, and task and instance specific semantics directly on the LLM decoder.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了$\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$，一种直接在LLM解码器上强制执行丰富上下文敏感约束以及任务和实例特定语义的统一方法。

sentences.en: Our approach integrates token-level MCTS which is guided by specific syntactic and semantic constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法整合了由特定句法和语义约束引导的token级MCTS。

sentences.en: The constraints over desired outputs are expressed using Answer Set Grammars, which is a logic-based formalism that generalizes context sensitive grammars while incorporating background knowledge to represent task-specific semantics.
sentences.zh: 对期望输出的约束使用答案集文法（Answer Set Grammars）来表达，这是一种基于逻辑的形式体系，在泛化上下文敏感语法的同时融入背景知识以表示任务特定的语义。

sentences.en: We show that our approach helps guarantee valid completions for any off-the-shelf LLM without the need for fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，我们的方法有助于为任何现成的LLM保证有效补全，而无需微调。

sentences.en: We evaluate $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ on a range of tasks, including synthetic grammar synthesis, combinatorial reasoning, JSON parsing, and planning.
sentences.zh: 我们在一系列任务上评估了$\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$，包括合成文法生成、组合推理、JSON解析和规划。

sentences.en: Our experimental results demonstrate that $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ allows even small pre-trained LLMs to efficiently outperform larger variants and state-of-the-art reasoning models (e.g., $\text{\textit{o4-mini}}$) while simultaneously guaranteeing semantic validity.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验结果证明，$\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$甚至能让小型预训练LLM在保证语义有效性的同时，高效地超越更大的变体和最先进的推理模型（如$\text{\textit{o4-mini}}$）。

title_en: Sem-Detect: Semantic Level Detection of AI Generated Peer-Reviews
title_zh: Sem-Detect：AI生成同行评审的语义级检测

sentences.en: *How can we distinguish whether a peer review was written by a human or generated by an AI model?* We argue that, in this setting, authorship should not be attributed solely from the textual features of a review, but also from the ideas, judgments, and claims it expresses.
sentences.zh: *我们如何区分一篇同行评审是由人类撰写还是由AI生成？*我们认为在此情形下，不应仅依据评审的文本特征来归因作者身份，还应依据其表达的观点、判断和主张。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose Sem-Detect, an authorship detection method for peer reviews that operationalizes this principle by combining textual features with claim-level semantic analysis.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了Sem-Detect，一种面向同行评审的作者身份检测方法，它将文本特征与主张级语义分析相结合来践行这一原则。

sentences.en: Sem-Detect compares a target review against multiple AI-generated reviews of the same paper, leveraging the observation that different AI models tend to converge on similar points, while human reviewers introduce more unique and diverse ones.
sentences.zh: Sem-Detect将目标评审与同一篇论文的多篇AI生成评审进行比较，利用了不同AI模型趋于在相似点上收敛、而人类评审者会引入更多独特且多样观点的观察。

sentences.en: As a result, Sem-Detect is able to distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from authentic human-written ones, including those that have been refined using an LLM but still reflect human judgment.
sentences.zh: 因此，Sem-Detect能够区分完全由AI生成的评审与真实的人类撰写评审，包括那些经过LLM精炼但仍反映人类判断的评审。

sentences.en: Across a dataset of over 20,000 peer reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS conferences, Sem-Detect improves over the strongest prior detector by 36.5% in TPR@1% FPR in the binary setting.
sentences.zh: 在来自ICLR和NeurIPS会议的超过20000篇同行评审数据集上，在二元设置中，Sem-Detect在TPR@1% FPR上比最强先验检测器改进了36.5%。

sentences.en: More importantly, in the three-class scenario, we empirically show that LLM refinement preserves the semantic signals of human reviews, which remain distinct from the patterns exhibited by fully AI-generated text; as a result, fewer than 3.5% of LLM-refined human reviews are misclassified as AI-generated.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，在三类场景中，我们实证表明LLM精炼保留了人类评审的语义信号，这些信号与完全AI生成文本所表现的模式仍然不同；因此，不到3.5%的经LLM精炼的人类评审被误分类为AI生成的。

title_en: SEMA: a Scalable and Efficient Mamba like Attention via Token Localization and Averaging
title_zh: SEMA：通过token定位与平均的可扩展高效Mamba式注意力

sentences.en: Attention is the critical component of a transformer.
sentences.zh: 注意力是transformer的关键组成部分。

sentences.en: Yet the quadratic computational complexity of vanilla full attention in the input size and the inability of its linear attention variant to focus have been challenges for computer vision tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，普通全注意力在输入规模上的二次计算复杂度，以及其线性注意力变体无法聚焦的问题，一直是计算机视觉任务的挑战。

sentences.en: We provide a mathematical definition of generalized attention and formulate both vanilla softmax attention and linear attention within the general framework.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了广义注意力的数学定义，并将普通softmax注意力和线性注意力都纳入这一通用框架。

sentences.en: We prove that generalized attention disperses, that is, as the number of keys tends to infinity, the query assigns equal weights to all keys.
sentences.zh: 我们证明广义注意力会发散，即当key数量趋于无穷时，query对所有key分配相等的权重。

sentences.en: Motivated by the dispersion property and recent development of Mamba form of attention, we design Scalable and Efficient Mamba like Attention (SEMA) which utilizes token localization to avoid dispersion and maintain focusing, complemented by theoretically consistent arithmetic averaging to capture global aspect of attention.
sentences.zh: 受发散性质以及注意力Mamba形式近期发展的启发，我们设计了可扩展高效Mamba式注意力（SEMA），它利用token定位来避免发散并保持聚焦，辅以理论上一致的算术平均来捕捉注意力的全局方面。

sentences.en: We support our approach on Imagenet-1k where classification results show that SEMA is a scalable and effective alternative beyond linear attention, outperforming recent vision Mamba models on increasingly larger scales of images at similar model parameter sizes.
sentences.zh: 我们在ImageNet-1k上验证了我们的方法，分类结果表明SEMA是超越线性注意力的一个可扩展且有效的替代方案，在相似的模型参数量下，在日益更大的图像规模上优于近期的视觉Mamba模型。

sentences.en: Source code can be found at: https://github.com/nhatthanhtran/SEMA.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/nhatthanhtran/SEMA 获取。

title_en: Semantic Cache Distillation: Efficient State Transfer via Reuse and Selective Patching
title_zh: 语义缓存蒸馏：通过复用与选择性修补的高效状态迁移

sentences.en: Disaggregated serving alleviates memory bottlenecks in Large Language Model (LLM) inference but creates a severe communication bottleneck: transmitting high-dimensional Key-Value (KV) caches often dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT).
sentences.zh: 分离式服务缓解了大语言模型（LLM）推理中的内存瓶颈，但造成了严重的通信瓶颈：传输高维键值（KV）缓存往往主导了首token延迟（TTFT）。

sentences.en: Moreover, reusing caches across heterogeneous models (e.g., base and fine-tuned variants) causes semantic misalignment that accumulates over layers, degrading generation quality.
sentences.zh: 此外，跨异构模型（如基座与微调变体）复用缓存会造成随层累积的语义错位，降低生成质量。

sentences.en: We propose Semantic Cache Distillation (SCD), a loss-constrained framework that replaces raw KV transmission with compact semantic codes.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了语义缓存蒸馏（SCD），一个受损失约束的框架，用紧凑的语义编码取代原始的KV传输。

sentences.en: SCD addresses these challenges via two mechanisms: (1) Reuse, which reconstructs most layers from low-rank subspaces to minimize transfer cost, and (2) Patch, which predicts normalized inputs at sparse transition layers to truncate error propagation.
sentences.zh: SCD通过两种机制解决这些挑战：（1）复用（Reuse），从低秩子空间中重建大部分层以最小化迁移成本；（2）修补（Patch），在稀疏过渡层预测归一化输入以截断误差传播。

sentences.en: Empirically, SCD delivers up to 2.65 $\times$ TTFT speedup over the oracle consumer prefill and dominates quantization and selective recomputation baselines on the quality--latency Pareto frontier in bandwidth-constrained regimes, while keeping generation quality within 5\% F1 of the oracle.
sentences.zh: 实验上，SCD相比oracle消费者预填充实现了高达2.65$\times$的TTFT加速，并在带宽受限场景中主导了质量-延迟Pareto前沿上的量化和选择性重计算基线，同时将生成质量保持在oracle的5\% F1以内。

title_en: Semantic Editing with Coupled Stochastic Differential Equations
title_zh: 利用耦合随机微分方程进行语义编辑

sentences.en: Editing the content of an image with a pretrained text-to-image model remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 使用预训练的文生图模型编辑图像内容仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing methods often distort fine details or introduce unintended artifacts.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往会扭曲细节或引入意外的人工痕迹。

sentences.en: We propose using coupled stochastic differential equations (coupled SDEs) to guide the sampling process of any pre-trained generative model that can be sampled by solving an SDE, including diffusion and rectified flow models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出使用耦合随机微分方程（coupled SDE）来引导任何可通过求解SDE进行采样的预训练生成模型（包括扩散模型和整流流模型）的采样过程。

sentences.en: By driving both the source image and the edited image with the same correlated noise, our approach steers new samples toward the desired semantics while preserving visual similarity to the source.
sentences.zh: 通过用相同的相关噪声驱动源图像和编辑后的图像，我们的方法将新样本引向期望的语义，同时保持与源的视觉相似性。

sentences.en: The method works out-of-the-box—without retraining or auxiliary networks—and achieves high prompt fidelity along with near-pixel-level consistency.
sentences.zh: 该方法开箱即用——无需重训练或辅助网络——并能实现高提示保真度和接近像素级的一致性。

sentences.en: These results position coupled SDEs as a simple yet powerful tool for controlled generative AI.
sentences.zh: 这些结果将耦合SDE定位为受控生成式AI中一种简单而强大的工具。

title_en: Semantic Granularity Navigation in Image Editing
title_zh: 图像编辑中的语义粒度导航

sentences.en: Despite the generative capabilities of diffusion and flow models, real-image editing remains constrained by a persistent trade-off between semantic editability and structural fidelity.
sentences.zh: 尽管扩散和流模型具备生成能力，真实图像编辑仍受制于语义可编辑性与结构保真度之间持续存在的权衡。

sentences.en: We trace a primary cause of this limitation to the implicit coupling of edit progress with model scale in existing paradigms.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一局限的一个主要原因归因于现有范式中编辑进度与模型规模的隐式耦合。

sentences.en: Under this coupling, stronger edits typically require visiting noisier states, which spends computation on destabilizing layout before the semantic change is well localized.
sentences.zh: 在这种耦合下，更强的编辑通常需要访问更嘈杂的状态，这会在语义变化被良好定位之前，将计算浪费在破坏布局上。

sentences.en: We introduce NaviEdit, a training-free inference-time controller that decouples edit progress from model scale traversal through a strict self-consistency contract.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了NaviEdit，一个无需训练的推理时控制器，通过严格的自我一致性契约将编辑进度与模型规模遍历解耦。

sentences.en: NaviEdit operates at the rollout level and leaves the underlying pretrained model unchanged.
sentences.zh: NaviEdit在rollout层面运行，使底层预训练模型保持不变。

sentences.en: It treats scale as a control input and reallocates a fixed step budget toward semantically responsive intermediate scales instead of destructive high-noise regimes.
sentences.zh: 它将规模视为控制输入，并将固定的步数预算重新分配给语义响应及时的中间尺度，而非破坏性的高噪声阶段。

sentences.en: Experiments show positive average gains across compatible editors and flow backbones, supporting decoupling as a portable inference-time control principle.
sentences.zh: 实验显示，在兼容的编辑器和流骨干上取得了平均正向增益，支持将解耦作为一种可移植的推理时控制原则。

title_en: Semantic Impact–Driven Visual Scheduling in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中语义影响驱动的视觉调度

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffer from high inference latency due to long visual sequences.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）因较长的视觉序列而遭受高推理延迟。

sentences.en: To enable efficient, on-demand utilization of visual information, we argue that visual necessity should be assessed by its semantic impact on the output distribution, rather than inferred from intermediate interaction signals such as attention weights.
sentences.zh: 为实现高效、按需的视觉信息利用，我们认为视觉必要性应通过其对输出分布的语义影响来评估，而不是从注意力权重等中间交互信号中推断。

sentences.en: We propose a training-free framework based on token embedding subspace decomposition, which we term a prediction-conditioned Semantic Lens.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个基于token嵌入子空间分解的免训练框架，称之为预测条件语义透镜（Semantic Lens）。

sentences.en: Specifically, at fixed decoding intervals, we perform QR decomposition on the Top-K candidate token embeddings to construct an orthogonal semantic basis.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在固定的解码间隔处，我们对Top-K候选token嵌入执行QR分解，以构建一个正交语义基。

sentences.en: We then introduce Semantic IImpact–Driven Visual Scheduling (SIVS), which measures how visual inputs impact model predictions by projecting visual-induced hidden-state variations onto this semantic lens.
sentences.zh: 然后我们引入语义影响驱动的视觉调度（SIVS），通过将视觉引发的隐藏状态变化投影到该语义透镜上，来度量视觉输入如何影响模型预测。

sentences.en: SIVS provides a geometrically grounded, impact-driven criterion for dynamic visual KV scheduling.
sentences.zh: SIVS为动态视觉KV调度提供了几何上有依据、受影响驱动的准则。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that SIVS achieves ~87% visual KV compression while maintaining over 99% of model performance.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，SIVS实现了约87%的视觉KV压缩，同时保持了超过99%的模型性能。

title_en: Semantic Integrity Matters: Benchmarking and Preserving High-Density Reasoning in KV Cache Compression
title_zh: 语义完整性至关重要：KV缓存压缩中高密度推理的基准测试与保持

sentences.en: While Key-Value (KV) cache compression is essential for efficient LLM inference, current evaluations disproportionately focus on \textbf{sparse retrieval} tasks, potentially masking the degradation of High-Density Reasoning where Chain-of-Thought (CoT) coherence is critical.
sentences.zh: 虽然键值（KV）缓存压缩对高效的LLM推理至关重要，但当前的评估过度聚焦于\textbf{稀疏检索}任务，可能掩盖了高密度推理（其中思维链（CoT）连贯性至关重要）的退化。

sentences.en: We introduce KVFundaBench to systematically evaluate this gap, revealing a sharp dichotomy: while retrieval tasks remain robust, reasoning tasks exhibit severe Task-Dependent Degradation under aggressive compression due to disrupted CoT links.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了KVFundaBench来系统评估这一差距，揭示出一个鲜明的二分：检索任务保持稳健，而推理任务在激进压缩下因CoT链中断而表现出严重的任务相关退化。

sentences.en: Extending our analysis to the DeepSeek-R1 model, we uncover that its specialized attention patterns offer unique insights into the fragility of reasoning chains.
sentences.zh: 将我们的分析扩展到DeepSeek-R1模型，我们发现其特有的注意力模式为推理链的脆弱性提供了独特见解。

sentences.en: Guided by these findings—specifically the necessity of preserving few-shot examples as indivisible \textbf{Semantic Units}—we propose ShotKV.
sentences.zh: 在这些发现——具体而言，需要将少样本示例保留为不可分割的\textbf{语义单元}——的指导下，我们提出了ShotKV。

sentences.en: This approach explicitly separates prefill and decoding phases to prioritize semantic integrity.
sentences.zh: 该方法显式分离预填充和解码阶段，以优先保证语义完整性。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that ShotKV achieves 9\%-18\% accuracy improvements on long-context generation tasks and effectively generalizes to document QA, all while delivering an 11\% latency reduction compared to full cache inference.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，ShotKV在长上下文生成任务上实现了9\%到18\%的准确率提升，并有效泛化到文档问答，同时相比完整缓存推理实现了11\%的延迟降低。

title_en: Semantic Robustness Certification for Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉-语言模型的语义鲁棒性认证

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are now widely used in downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）现已广泛应用于下游任务。

sentences.en: However, real-world applications often expose VLMs to distribution shifts induced by semantic variation (e.g., shape, size, and style).
sentences.zh: 然而，现实应用往往使VLM暴露于由语义变化（如形状、大小和风格）引起的分布偏移中。

sentences.en: Robustness certification determines if a model’s prediction changes when transformations are applied to its input.
sentences.zh: 鲁棒性认证旨在确定当对模型输入施加变换时，模型的预测是否发生变化。

sentences.en: While most certification frameworks study geometric or pixel-level transformations over inputs, this work proposes a novel framework that enables certifying VLM robustness under semantic-level transformations.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数认证框架研究的是输入上的几何或像素级变换，但本工作提出了一个新颖的框架，能够在语义级变换下认证VLM的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Leveraging the open-vocabulary capability of VLMs, we use text prompts as semantic proxies to construct transformations parameterized by an extent that controls the degree of semantic variation.
sentences.zh: 利用VLM的开放词汇能力，我们使用文本提示作为语义代理，构建由控制语义变化程度的extent参数化的变换。

sentences.en: By characterizing the VLM decision boundary in closed form, our framework quantitatively certifies extent intervals for which the predicted class remains unchanged under the semantic transformation.
sentences.zh: 通过以闭式形式刻画VLM的决策边界，我们的框架定量地认证在语义变换下预测类别保持不变的范围区间。

sentences.en: Our framework is the first to certify VLM robustness under semantic-level variations without requiring additional data for each variation, making it practical to apply.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架是首个在语义级变化下认证VLM鲁棒性、且无需为每种变化提供额外数据的框架，使其易于应用。

sentences.en: Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data show that our framework enables certifying robustness under diverse semantic variations across scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，我们的框架能够在多种场景下对多样语义变化下的鲁棒性进行认证。

title_en: Semantic Router: On the Feasibility of Hijacking MLLMs via a Single Adversarial Perturbation
title_zh: 语义路由器：通过单一对抗扰动劫持MLLM的可行性研究

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in stateless systems, such as autonomous driving and robotics.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被部署在无状态系统中，例如自动驾驶和机器人。

sentences.en: This paper investigates a novel threat: Semantic-Aware Hijacking.
sentences.zh: 本文研究一种新型威胁：语义感知劫持。

sentences.en: We explore the feasibility of hijacking multiple stateless decisions simultaneously using a single universal perturbation.
sentences.zh: 我们探索了使用单个通用扰动同时劫持多项无状态决策的可行性。

sentences.en: We introduce the Semantic-Aware Universal Perturbation (SAUP), which acts as a semantic router, "actively" perceiving input semantics and routing them to distinct, attacker-defined targets.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了语义感知通用扰动（SAUP），它充当一个语义路由器，“主动”感知输入语义并将其路由到不同的、由攻击者定义的目标。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we conduct a theoretical and empirical analysis on the geometric properties in the latent space.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一目标，我们对潜在空间中的几何性质进行了理论和实证分析。

sentences.en: Guided by these insights, we propose the Semantic-Oriented (SORT) optimization strategy and annotate a new dataset with fine-grained semantics to evaluate performance.
sentences.zh: 在这些洞察的引导下，我们提出了面向语义（SORT）的优化策略，并标注了一个具有细粒度语义的新数据集来评估性能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on three representative MLLMs demonstrate the fundamental feasibility of this attack, achieving a 66% attack success rate over five targets using a single frame against Qwen.
sentences.zh: 在三个代表性MLLM上的大量实验证明了这种攻击的基本可行性：在针对Qwen的一个单帧上，对五个目标实现了66%的攻击成功率。
