title_en: Semantic Tube Prediction: Beating LLM Data Efficiency with JEPA
title_zh: 语义管预测：用JEPA超越LLM的数据效率

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) obey consistent scaling laws---empirical power-law fits that predict how loss decreases with compute, data, and parameters.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）遵循一致的扩展定律——预测损失如何随计算量、数据和参数而下降的经验幂律拟合。

sentences.en: While predictive, these laws are descriptive rather than prescriptive: they characterize typical training, not optimal training.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些定律具有预测性，但它们是描述性的而非规定性的：它们刻画的是典型训练，而非最优训练。

sentences.en: Surprisingly few works have successfully challenged the data-efficiency bounds implied by these laws---which is our primary focus.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，很少有工作成功挑战了这些定律所隐含的数据效率界限——而这正是我们的首要关注点。

sentences.en: To that end, we introduce the Geodesic Hypothesis, positing that token sequences trace geodesics on a smooth semantic manifold and are therefore locally linear.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了测地线假说，假设token序列在光滑的语义流形上沿线测地线运动，因此是局部线性的。

sentences.en: Building on this principle, we propose a novel Semantic Tube Prediction (STP) task, a JEPA-style regularizer that confines hidden-state trajectories to a tubular neighborhood of the geodesic.
sentences.zh: 基于这一原理，我们提出了一种新颖的语义管预测（STP）任务，一种JEPA风格的正则化器，将隐藏状态轨迹约束在测地线的管状邻域内。

sentences.en: STP generalizes JEPA to language without requiring explicit multi-view augmentations.
sentences.zh: STP将JEPA推广到语言，而无需显式的多视角增广。

sentences.en: We show this constraint improves signal-to-noise ratio, and consequently preserves diversity by preventing trajectory collisions during inference.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这一约束改善了信噪比，并通过防止推理过程中的轨迹碰撞来保持多样性。

sentences.en: Empirically, STP allows LLMs to match baseline accuracy with 16$\times$ less training data, directly violating the data term of fine-tuning scaling laws and demonstrating that principled geometric priors can surpass brute-force scaling.
sentences.zh: 实验上，STP使LLM用少16$\times$的训练数据即达到基线准确率，直接违反了微调扩展定律中的数据项，证明有原则的几何先验可以超越蛮力扩展。

sentences.en: Code: \url{https://github.com/galilai-group/llm-jepa#stp}
sentences.zh: 代码：\url{https://github.com/galilai-group/llm-jepa#stp}

title_en: Semantic-Aware Motion Encoding for Topology-Agnostic Character Animation
title_zh: 面向拓扑无关角色动画的语义感知运动编码

sentences.en: Generalizing motion representation across diverse characters remains challenging due to significant topological variations in skeletal structures across datasets and species, which hinder the development of scalable generative models.
sentences.zh: 由于数据集与物种之间骨骼结构存在显著的拓扑差异，跨多样角色泛化的运动表示仍然具有挑战性，这阻碍了可扩展生成模型的发展。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose a Semantic-Aware Topology-Agnostic framework that learns a unified latent manifold shared by disparate species.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个语义感知的拓扑无关框架，学习由不同物种共享的统一潜在流形。

sentences.en: Unlike methods relying on fixed hierarchies or rigid padding strategies, our approach leverages a semantic modulation mechanism to align functional joint correspondences, thereby decoupling motion from topology.
sentences.zh: 与依赖固定层级或僵化填充策略的方法不同，我们的方法利用语义调制机制来对齐功能性关节对应关系，从而将运动与拓扑解耦。

sentences.en: This design enables the construction of a continuous, generative-friendly motion space from large-scale, unaligned raw BVH data.
sentences.zh: 这一设计能够从大规模、未对齐的原始BVH数据中构建一个连续、利于生成的运动空间。

sentences.en: Experiments on human and animal datasets demonstrate that our framework achieves high-fidelity reconstruction and supports downstream text-to-motion tasks.
sentences.zh: 在人类和动物数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架实现了高保真重建，并支持下游的文本到运动任务。

sentences.en: Notably, the model enables zero-shot cross-species retargeting without paired data.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该模型无需配对数据即可实现零样本的跨物种重定向。

sentences.en: Code and demos are available at https://github.com/zzysteve/SATA
sentences.zh: 代码和演示可在 https://github.com/zzysteve/SATA 获取。

title_en: Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning
title_zh: 语义增强的潜在视觉推理

sentences.en: Multimodal latent-space reasoning aims to replace explicit “thinking with images” by performing visual reasoning directly in a compact latent space.
sentences.zh: 多模态潜在空间推理旨在通过在紧凑的潜在空间中直接执行视觉推理，来替代显式“与图像一起思考”。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches largely rely on visual supervision and produce latent representations that lack sufficient semantic richness, limiting their ability to support diverse region-level reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在很大程度上依赖视觉监督，所产生的潜在表征缺乏足够的语义丰富性，限制了它们支持多样化区域级推理任务的能力。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce \textbf{Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR)}, a two-stage learning framework that enriches latent representations with attribute-level visual semantics and aligns them with diverse reasoning objectives.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入了\textbf{Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR)}（语义增强的潜在视觉推理），一个两阶段学习框架，用属性级视觉语义丰富潜在表征，并将其与多样化的推理目标对齐。

sentences.en: In the first stage, SLVR learns semantically enriched region-centric latents under fine-grained attribute supervision.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，SLVR在细粒度属性监督下学习语义丰富的以区域为中心的潜在表征。

sentences.en: In the second stage, we design Multi-query Group Relative Policy Optimization (M-GRPO) to align latent representations across multiple queries grounded in the same region.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，我们设计了多查询组相对策略优化（M-GRPO），以在同一区域基础上对齐跨多个查询的潜在表征。

sentences.en: To support this framework, we construct \textbf{SLV-Set}, comprising approximately 400K region-level attribute annotations and 800K multi-query question answering samples, and introduce \textbf{SV-QA}, a benchmark that evaluates latent reasoning under semantic variation.
sentences.zh: 为支持该框架，我们构建了\textbf{SLV-Set}，包含约40万个区域级属性标注和80万个多查询问答样本，并引入了\textbf{SV-QA}，一个在语义变化下评估潜在推理的基准。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that SLVR improves the robustness and semantic consistency of latent visual reasoning compared to existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，与现有基线相比，SLVR提升了潜在视觉推理的鲁棒性和语义一致性。

sentences.en: Our code and datasets are available at \url{https://github.com/tinnel123666888/slvr}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据集可在\url{https://github.com/tinnel123666888/slvr}获取。

title_en: Semantic-level Backdoor Attack against Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: 针对文本到图像扩散模型的语义级后门攻击

sentences.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models are widely adopted for their strong generative capabilities, yet remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks.
sentences.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型因其强大的生成能力而被广泛采用，但仍易受后门攻击。

sentences.en: Existing attacks typically rely on fixed textual triggers and single-entity backdoor targets, making them highly susceptible to enumeration-based input defenses and attention-consistency detection.
sentences.zh: 现有攻击通常依赖固定的文本触发器与单实体后门目标，使其极易受基于枚举的输入防御和注意力一致性检测影响。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Semantic-level Backdoor Attack (SemBD), which introduces representation-level triggers based on continuous semantic regions rather than discrete textual patterns.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了语义级后门攻击（SemBD），它引入基于连续语义区域而非离散文本模式的表征级触发器。

sentences.en: SemBD implants such semantic backdoors by distillation-based editing of the key and value projection matrices in cross-attention layers, enabling semantically equivalent but textually diverse prompts to activate the backdoor.
sentences.zh: SemBD通过基于蒸馏的方式编辑交叉注意力层中的键和值投影矩阵来植入此类语义后门，使语义等价但文本多样的提示能够激活后门。

sentences.en: To further enhance stealthiness, SemBD incorporates a semantic regularization to prevent unintended activation under incomplete semantics, as well as multi-entity backdoor targets that avoid highly consistent cross-attention patterns.
sentences.zh: 为进一步增强隐蔽性，SemBD融入了语义正则化，以防止在不完整语义下发生意外激活，并使用多实体后门目标以避免高度一致的交叉注意力模式。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SemBD achieves a 100% attack success rate while maintaining strong robustness against state-of-the-art input-level defenses.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SemBD实现了100%的攻击成功率，同时在对最先进的输入级防御上保持了强大的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/DPAS-Lab/SemBD/.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/DPAS-Lab/SemBD/ 获取。

title_en: SemanticNVS: Improving Semantic Scene Understanding in Generative Novel View Synthesis
title_zh: SemanticNVS：提升生成式新视角合成中的语义场景理解

sentences.en: We present SemanticNVS, a camera-conditioned multi-view diffusion model for novel view synthesis (NVS), which improves generation quality and consistency by integrating pre-trained semantic feature extractors.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SemanticNVS，一种用于新视角合成（NVS）的相机条件多视角扩散模型，通过整合预训练语义特征提取器来提升生成质量和一致性。

sentences.en: Existing NVS methods perform well for views near the input view, however, they tend to generate semantically implausible and distorted images under long-range camera motion, revealing severe degradation.
sentences.zh: 现有NVS方法在靠近输入视角的视角上表现良好，但在远距离相机运动下往往生成在语义上不合理且变形的图像，暴露出严重的退化。

sentences.en: We speculate that this degradation is due to current models failing to fully understand their conditioning or intermediate generated scene content.
sentences.zh: 我们推测这种退化是因为当前模型未能完全理解其条件信息或中间生成的场景内容。

sentences.en: Here, we propose to integrate pre-trained semantic feature extractors to incorporate stronger scene semantics as conditioning to achieve high-quality generation even at distant viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出整合预训练语义特征提取器，以纳入更强的场景语义作为条件，从而即使在远距离视角下也能实现高质量生成。

sentences.en: We investigate two different strategies, (1) warped semantic features and (2) an alternating scheme of understanding and generation at each denoising step.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了两种不同策略：（1）翘曲语义特征，以及（2）在每一步去噪中进行理解与生成的交替方案。

sentences.en: Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate the clear qualitative and quantitative (4.69%-15.26% in FID) improvement over state-of-the-art alternatives.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集上的实验结果表明，相比最先进的替代方法，我们的方法在定性和定量（FID提升4.69%%-15.26%%）上均有明显改进。

title_en: SemBind: Binding Diffusion Watermarks to Semantics Against Black-Box Forgery Attacks
title_zh: SemBind：将扩散水印绑定到语义以抵御黑盒伪造攻击

sentences.en: Latent-based watermarks, embedded during the generation process of latent diffusion models (LDMs), facilitate detection and attribution of generated images.
sentences.zh: 潜在空间水印在潜在扩散模型（LDM）的生成过程中被嵌入，便于对生成图像进行检测和溯源。

sentences.en: However, recent black-box forgery attacks can implant a provider's watermark into images not generated by that provider, using at least one watermarked image and black-box access to the model, thereby undermining provenance and trust.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期的黑盒伪造攻击可以将某个提供方的水印植入并非由该提供方生成的图像中，其手段是使用至少一张带水印的图像以及对模型的黑盒访问，从而破坏溯源与信任。

sentences.en: We propose SemBind, the first defense framework for latent-based watermarks against black-box forgery, which binds latent watermark signals to image semantics through a contrastively trained semantic masker.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SemBind，第一个针对潜在空间水印抵御黑盒伪造的防御框架，它通过一个对比训练的语义掩蔽器将潜在水印信号绑定到图像语义上。

sentences.en: The masker produces near-invariant codes for semantically matched prompts and near-orthogonal codes across different prompts, enabling SemBind to modulate the target latent before applying standard latent-based watermarking schemes.
sentences.zh: 该掩蔽器为语义匹配的提示产生近似不变的编码，并在不同提示之间产生近似正交的编码，使SemBind能够在应用标准潜在空间水印方案之前调制目标潜在变量。

sentences.en: Across four mainstream latent-based watermarking methods, SemBind substantially reduces false acceptance under black-box forgery while preserving image quality and offering a tunable robustness--security trade-off via a simple mask-ratio parameter.
sentences.zh: 在四种主流的潜在空间水印方法上，SemBind大幅降低了黑盒伪造下的误接受率，同时保持图像质量，并通过一个简单的掩蔽率参数提供可调的鲁棒性-安全性权衡。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/XinZhang1999/SemBind.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/XinZhang1999/SemBind 获取。

title_en: Semi-knockoffs: a model-agnostic conditional independence testing method with finite-sample guarantees
title_zh: 半knockoffs：一种具有有限样本保证的模型无关条件独立检验方法

sentences.en: Conditional independence testing (CIT) is essential for reliable scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 条件独立检验（CIT）对于可靠的科学发现至关重要。

sentences.en: It prevents spurious findings and enables controlled feature selection.
sentences.zh: 它能防止虚假发现，并实现受控的特征选择。

sentences.en: Recent CIT methods have used machine learning (ML) models as surrogates of the underlying distribution.
sentences.zh: 近期的CIT方法利用机器学习（ML）模型作为底层分布的替代。

sentences.en: However, model-agnostic approaches require a train-test split, which reduces statistical power.
sentences.zh: 然而，模型无关的方法需要训练-测试分割，这会降低统计功效。

sentences.en: We introduce Semi-knockoffs, a CIT method that can accommodate any pre-trained model, avoids this split, and provides valid p-values and false discovery rate (FDR) control for high-dimensional settings.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了Semi-knockoffs，一种CIT方法，可以容纳任何预训练模型，避免这种分割，并为高维设置提供有效的p值和错误发现率（FDR）控制。

sentences.en: Unlike methods that rely on the model-$X$ assumption (known input distribution), Semi-knockoffs only require conditional expectations for continuous variables.
sentences.zh: 与依赖模型-$X$假设（已知输入分布）的方法不同，Semi-knockoffs仅需要对连续变量的条件期望。

sentences.en: This makes the procedure less restrictive and more practical for machine learning integration.
sentences.zh: 这使得该过程限制更少，更适合机器学习集成。

sentences.en: To ensure validity when these expectations are estimated, we present two new theoretical results: (i) stability for regularized models trained with a null feature and (ii) the double-robustness property.
sentences.zh: 为确保这些期望被估计时的有效性，我们提出了两个新的理论结果：（i）对使用空特征训练的正则化模型的稳定性，以及（ii）双重稳健性性质。

title_en: Semi-LAR: Semi-supervised Contrastive Learning with Linear Attention for Removal of Nighttime Flares
title_zh: Semi-LAR：面向夜间眩光去除的线性注意力半监督对比学习

sentences.en: Lens flare removal is challenging due to the large spatial extent of flare artifacts and their entangle-ment with scene structures, while existing meth-ods heavily rely on large-scale paired data.
sentences.zh: 由于眩光伪影的空间范围大且与场景结构纠缠在一起，镜头眩光去除具有挑战性，而现有方法严重依赖大规模配对数据。

sentences.en: We propose a semi-supervised flare removal frame-work that enables stable learning from unlabeled images by jointly addressing pseudo-label relia-bility and representation discrimination.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个半监督眩光去除框架，通过共同处理伪标签可靠性与表示判别性，实现从无标签图像的稳定学习。

sentences.en: We pro-pose an adaptive pseudo-label repository that pro-gressively refines pseudo supervision through no-reference quality assessment, momentum-based updates, and invalid label filtering, effectively mit-igating error accumulation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个自适应伪标签库，通过无参考质量评估、动量更新和无效标签过滤逐步精化伪监督，有效缓解误差累积。

sentences.en: Moreover, we pro-pose a flare-aware contrastive loss that explic-itly treats flare-contaminated inputs as negatives and performs patch-level contrastive learning, en-couraging representations that are discriminative against flare patterns while remaining consistent with reliable pseudo targets.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一个眩光感知对比损失，将受眩光污染的输入显式视为负样本并进行补丁级对比学习，从而鼓励对眩光模式具判别性、同时与可靠伪目标保持一致的表示。

sentences.en: Extensive experi-ments on multiple flare benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework is model-agnostic and consistently improves performance and ro-bustness.
sentences.zh: 在多个眩光基准上的大量实验表明，所提出的框架是模型无关的，并持续改进性能和鲁棒性。

title_en: Semi-Supervised Gaze Estimation via Disentangled Subspace Contrastive Learning
title_zh: 通过解耦子空间对比学习的半监督注视估计

sentences.en: Appearance-based gaze estimation always suffers from poor generalization due to limited annotated samples and insufficient dataset diversity.
sentences.zh: 基于外观的注视估计由于标注样本有限和数据集多样性不足，一直存在泛化能力差的问题。

sentences.en: Leading approaches adopt weakly supervised learning to generate large-scale pseudo-labeled data from unconstrained real-world scenarios, aiming to mitigate the domain shifts.
sentences.zh: 领先的方法采用弱监督学习，从不受约束的真实世界场景中生成大规模伪标注数据，以期缓解域偏移。

sentences.en: In this work, we devise a simple yet effective semi-supervised learning architecture that leverages unlabeled data to enhance domain generalization, thereby reducing reliance on labor-intensive manual annotations.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们设计了一种简单而有效的半监督学习架构，利用无标签数据增强域泛化，从而减少对劳动密集的人工标注的依赖。

sentences.en: Our key insight is to impose Jacobian regularization to disentangle feature representations into discriminative subspaces dedicated to specific gaze components, such as pitch and yaw angles.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键见解是施加Jacobi正则化，将特征表示解耦为专用于特定注视组件（如俯仰角和偏航角）的判别性子空间。

sentences.en: We further exploit the intrinsic ordinal ranking within each subspace for contrastive learning, enabling the model to learn robust gaze representations from a small set of labeled samples and an abundance of unlabeled ones.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步利用每个子空间内部的固有序数排序进行对比学习，使模型能够从少量标注样本和大量无标签样本中学习到稳健的注视表示。

sentences.en: This ultimately yields our Disentangled Subspace Contrastive Learning (DSCL) framework.
sentences.zh: 这最终形成了我们的解耦子空间对比学习（DSCL）框架。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks verify that the proposed DSCL is plug-and-play, achieving competitive performance using only 20\%, 10\%, and even 5\% of the annotated data under both in-domain and cross-domain evaluation settings.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验验证了所提出的DSCL是即插即用的，在域内和跨域评估设置下，仅使用20\%、10\%甚至5\%的标注数据即可取得有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: The public code is available at \href{https://github.com/da60266/DSCL}{https://github.com/da60266/DSCL}.
sentences.zh: 公开代码可在\href{https://github.com/da60266/DSCL}{https://github.com/da60266/DSCL}获取。

title_en: Semi-Supervised Hypothesis Testing by Betting on Predictions
title_zh: 基于预测下注的半监督假设检验

sentences.en: We introduce a testing-by-betting framework that leverages predictions on unlabeled data to enhance the power of sequential hypothesis testing.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个基于下注的检验框架，利用无标签数据上的预测来增强序贯假设检验的功效。

sentences.en: Given limited samples from the joint distribution of $(X,Y)$, and additional unlabeled samples from the marginal of $X$, we ask how unlabeled data can be used to hypothesize about the distribution of $Y$, and the conditional distribution of $Y\mid X$.
sentences.zh: 给定来自$(X,Y)$联合分布的有限样本，以及来自$X$边缘分布的额外无标签样本，我们探究如何利用无标签数据来对$Y$的分布以及$Y\mid X$的条件分布作出假设。

sentences.en: We introduce an e-statistic and use it to construct a sequential test.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个e统计量，并用它构造序贯检验。

sentences.en: Under standard distributional assumptions---label shift or concept shift---we establish that the test is anytime valid.
sentences.zh: 在标准分布假设——标签偏移或概念偏移——下，我们建立了该检验的任意时刻有效性（anytime valid）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that for binary data, the e-statistic has non-trivial power.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明对于二值数据，该e统计量具有非平凡的功效。

sentences.en: Crucially, our approach retains these properties even when the underlying predictions are inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，即使底层预测不准确，我们的方法也能保持这些性质。

sentences.en: Through simulations and applications to large language models evaluation, we demonstrate power gains over baseline approaches, including prediction-powered inference.
sentences.zh: 通过模拟实验和对大语言模型评估的应用，我们展示了相比基线方法（包括预测驱动推断）的功效增益。

sentences.en: These gains persist even with relatively limited unlabeled data and when predictions have low accuracy due to weak correlation between $X$ and $Y$.
sentences.zh: 即使在无标签数据相对有限、且因$X$与$Y$之间相关性弱而导致预测准确率较低的情况下，这些增益依然存在。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus
title_zh: 通过集成一致性进行分子图的半监督学习

sentences.en: Machine learning is transforming molecular sciences by accelerating property prediction, simulation, and the discovery of new molecules and materials.
sentences.zh: 机器学习正通过加速性质预测、模拟以及新分子和新材料的发现来变革分子科学。

sentences.en: Acquiring labeled data in these domains is often costly and time-consuming, whereas large collections of unlabeled molecular data are readily available.
sentences.zh: 在这些领域中获取标注数据往往成本高昂且耗时，而大量的无标注分子数据则是现成可用的。

sentences.en: Standard semi-supervised learning methods often rely on label-preserving augmentations, which are challenging to design in the molecular domain, where minor changes can drastically alter properties.
sentences.zh: 标准的半监督学习方法通常依赖保持标签的增广，这在分子领域设计起来具有挑战性，因为微小的变化就可能导致性质急剧改变。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that semi-supervised methods that rely on an ensemble consensus can boost predictive accuracy across a diverse range of molecular datasets, task types, and graph neural network architectures.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明，依赖集成一致性的半监督方法可以在多样化的分子数据集、任务类型和图神经网络架构上提升预测准确率。

sentences.en: We find that training with an ensemble consensus objective increases robustness in models and exhibits an effect similar to knowledge distillation; an individual member of an ensemble trained this way outperforms a full ensemble trained in a traditional supervised fashion in almost all cases.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，使用集成一致性目标训练可增强模型的鲁棒性，并表现出类似知识蒸馏的效果；以这种方式训练的集成单个成员，在几乎所有情况下都优于以传统监督方式训练的完整集成。

sentences.en: In addition, this type of semi-supervised training reduces calibration error.
sentences.zh: 此外，这种半监督训练还能降低校准误差。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Semi-Supervised Learning with Noisy Proxy Covariates: Generalization Bounds and Distribution Regression
title_zh: 带噪代理协变量的半监督学习：泛化界与分布回归

sentences.en: In many modern machine learning pipelines, abundant pretrained representations serve as noisy proxy covariates, while task-specific labels remain scarce.
sentences.zh: 在许多现代机器学习流程中，丰富的预训练表示充当有噪代理协变量，而任务特定标签仍然稀缺。

sentences.en: We study semi-supervised regression in this setting, and propose a simple two stage estimator that learns kernel eigenfeatures from all proxy covariates and fits a ridge predictor on labeled data.
sentences.zh: 我们研究这种设置下的半监督回归，并提出一个简单的两阶段估计器：从所有代理协变量学习核特征函数，并在标注数据上拟合岭预测器。

sentences.en: We derive finite sample bounds showing that fast labeled sample rates are recovered when proxy perturbation is controlled and unlabeled proxy covariates are sufficiently abundant.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出有限样本界，表明当代理扰动受到控制且无标签代理协变量足够丰富时，可以恢复快速的有标签样本率。

sentences.en: We also show that distribution regression is a direct special case, with analogous guarantees when the finite bag size is large enough.
sentences.zh: 我们还表明，当有限袋尺寸足够大时，分布回归是一个直接的特例，具有类似保证。

sentences.en: Experiments show consistent gains over supervised and semi-supervised baselines, especially in low label regimes.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，相比监督和半监督基线，我们的方法在低标签场景下取得了持续一致的增益。

title_en: Semi-Supervised Neural Super-Resolution for Mesh-Based Simulations
title_zh: 面向网格仿真的半监督神经超分辨率

sentences.en: Mesh-based simulations provide high-fidelity solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs), but achieving such accuracy typically requires fine meshes, leading to substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 基于网格的仿真为偏微分方程（PDE）提供高保真解，但达到这种精度通常需要细网格，从而带来可观的计算开销。

sentences.en: Super-resolution techniques aim to mitigate this cost by reconstructing high-resolution (HR), high-fidelity solutions from low-cost, low-resolution (LR) counterparts.
sentences.zh: 超分辨率技术旨在通过从低成本的、低分辨率（LR）对应物重建高分辨率（HR）、高保真的解来缓解这一成本。

sentences.en: However, training neural networks for super-resolution often demands large amounts of expensive HR supervision data.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练用于超分辨率的神经网络往往需要大量昂贵的HR监督数据。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose SuperMeshNet, an HR data-efficient super-resolution framework for mesh-based simulations aided by message passing neural networks (MPNNs).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SuperMeshNet，一个借助消息传递神经网络（MPNN）的、面向网格仿真的HR数据高效超分辨率框架。

sentences.en: At its core, SuperMeshNet introduces complementary learning, a semi-supervised approach that effectively leverages both 1) a small amount of paired LR-HR data and 2) abundant unpaired LR data via two jointly trained, complementary MPNN-based models.
sentences.zh: 其核心是SuperMeshNet引入了互补学习，一种半监督方法，通过两个联合训练的、互补的基于MPNN的模型，有效利用1）少量配对的LR-HR数据以及2）大量未配对的LR数据。

sentences.en: Additionally, our model is enriched by inductive biases, which are empirically shown to further improve super-resolution performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的模型加入了归纳偏置，实验表明这能进一步改善超分辨率性能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SuperMeshNet requires 90% less HR data to achieve even lower root mean square error (RMSE) than that of the fully supervised benchmark without the inductive biases.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与不含归纳偏置的全监督基准相比，SuperMeshNet仅需少90%的HR数据即可达到更低的均方根误差（RMSE）。

sentences.en: The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/jykim-git/SuperMeshNet.git.
sentences.zh: 源代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/jykim-git/SuperMeshNet.git 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation: Transferring Knowledge from Noise Domain
title_zh: 半监督噪声适应：从噪声域迁移知识

sentences.en: Transfer learning aims to facilitate the learning of a target domain by transferring knowledge from a source domain.
sentences.zh: 迁移学习旨在通过从源域迁移知识来促进目标域的学习。

sentences.en: The source domain typically contains semantically meaningful samples (*e.g.*, images) to facilitate effective knowledge transfer.
sentences.zh: 源域通常包含语义上有意义的样本（*例如*，图像），以促进有效的知识迁移。

sentences.en: However, a recent study observes that the noise domain constructed from simple distributions (*e.g.*, Gaussian distributions) can serve as a surrogate source domain in the semi-supervised setting, where only a small proportion of target samples are labeled while most remain unlabeled.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期一项研究观察到，由简单分布（*例如*，高斯分布）构建的噪声域在半监督设置中可以充当替代源域，在该设置中只有一小部分目标样本被标注，而大多数仍保持未标注。

sentences.en: Based on this surprising observation, we formulate a novel problem termed *Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation* (SSNA), which aims to leverage a synthetic noise domain to improve the generalization of the target domain.
sentences.zh: 基于这一令人惊讶的观察，我们形式化了一个名为*半监督噪声适应*（SSNA）的新问题，旨在利用合成噪声域来改善目标域的泛化。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we first establish a generalization bound characterizing the effect of the noise domain on generalization, based on which we propose a Noise Adaptation Framework (NAF).
sentences.zh: 为解决该问题，我们首先建立了一个刻画噪声域对泛化影响的泛化界，并在此基础上提出了噪声适应框架（NAF）。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that NAF effectively leverages the noise domain to tighten the generalization bound of the target domain, leading to improved performance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，NAF有效利用噪声域来收紧目标域的泛化界，从而带来性能提升。

sentences.en: The codes are available at https://github.com/AIResearch-Group/SSNA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/AIResearch-Group/SSNA 获取。

title_en: SEMIR: Semantic Minor-Induced Representation Learning on Graphs for Visual Segmentation
title_zh: SEMIR：图上语义小类诱导的表示学习用于视觉分割

sentences.en: Segmenting small and sparse structures in large-scale images is fundamentally constrained by voxel-level, lattice-bound computation and extreme class imbalance--dense, full-resolution inference scales poorly and forces most pipelines to rely on fixed regionization or downsampling, coupling computational cost to image resolution and attenuating boundary evidence precisely where minority structures are most informative.
sentences.zh: 在大规模图像中分割细小而稀疏的结构，从根本上受限于体素级、网格束缚的计算和极度类别不平衡——密集的全分辨率推理扩展性差，迫使大多数流程依赖固定区域化或下采样，从而将计算成本与图像分辨率耦合，并恰好在小众结构最具信息量的地方削弱边界证据。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{SEMIR} (\emph{Semantic Minor-Induced Representation Learning}), a representation framework that decouples inference from the native grid by learning a task-adapted, topology-preserving latent graph representation with exact decoding.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了\textbf{SEMIR}（\emph{语义小类诱导的表示学习}），一个表示框架，通过学习带有精确解码的任务自适应、保持拓扑的潜在图表示，将推理从原生网格中解耦出来。

sentences.en: \textbf{SEMIR} transforms the underlying grid graph into a compact, boundary-aligned graph minor through parameterized edge contraction, node deletion, and edge deletion, while preserving an exact lifting map from minor predictions to lattice labels.
sentences.zh: \textbf{SEMIR}通过参数化的边收缩、节点删除和边删除，将底层网格图转化为紧凑的、边界对齐的图子式（graph minor），同时保留从小类预测到网格标签的精确提升映射。

sentences.en: Minor construction is formalized as a few-shot structure learning problem that replaces hand-tuned preprocessing with a \emph{boundary-alignment objective}: minor parameters are learned by maximizing agreement between predicted boundary elements and target-specific semantic edges under a \emph{boundary Dice criterion}, and the induced minor is annotated with scale- and rotation-robust geometric and intensity descriptors and supports efficient region-level inference via message passing on a graph neural network (GNN) with relational edge features.
sentences.zh: 小类构建被形式化为一个少样本结构学习问题，用\emph{边界对齐目标}取代人工调参的预处理：在\emph{边界Dice准则}下，通过最大化预测边界元素与目标特定语义边之间的一致性来学习小类参数，且得到的小类配有尺度与旋转鲁棒的几何和强度描述符，并通过带关系边特征的图神经网络（GNN）上的消息传递支持高效的区域级推理。

sentences.en: We benchmark \textbf{SEMIR} on three tumor segmentation datasets—\textbf{BraTS 2021}, \textbf{KiTS23}, and \textbf{LiTS}—where targets exhibit high structural variability and distributional uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个肿瘤分割数据集——\textbf{BraTS 2021}、\textbf{KiTS23}和\textbf{LiTS}——上对\textbf{SEMIR}进行基准测试，这些数据集的目标表现出高度的结构变异性和分布不确定性。

sentences.en: \textbf{SEMIR} yields consistent improvements in \emph{minority-structure Dice} at practical runtime.
sentences.zh: \textbf{SEMIR}在实用的运行时下，在\emph{minority-structure Dice}上取得了一致的改进。

sentences.en: More broadly, SEMIR establishes a framework for learning task-adapted, topology-preserving latent representations with exact decoding for high-resolution structured visual data.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地，SEMIR建立了一个用于学习任务自适应、保持拓扑且带精确解码的潜在表示以处理高分辨率结构化视觉数据的框架。

title_en: SemRep : Generative Code Representation Learning with Code Transformations
title_zh: SemRep：通过代码变换的生成式代码表示学习

sentences.en: Code transformation is a foundational capability in the software development process, where its effectiveness relies on constructing a high-quality code representation to characterize the input code semantics and guide the transformation.
sentences.zh: 代码变换是软件开发过程中的一项基础能力，其有效性依赖于构建高质量的代码表示来刻画输入代码语义并指导变换。

sentences.en: Existing approaches treat code transformation as an end-to-end learning task, leaving the construction of the representation needed for semantic reasoning implicit in model weights or relying on rigid compiler-level abstractions.
sentences.zh: 现有方法将代码变换视为端到端学习任务，使语义推理所需表示的构建隐式地落在模型权重中，或依赖僵化的编译器级抽象。

sentences.en: We present SemRep, a framework that improves code transformation through *generative code representation learning*.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SemRep，一个通过*生成式代码表示学习*改进代码变换的框架。

sentences.en: Our key insight is to employ the semantics-preserving transformations as the intermediate representation, which serves as both a generative mid-training task and the guidance for subsequent instruction-specific code transformations.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键见解是使用保持语义的变换作为中间表示，它既充当生成式中间训练任务，又充当后续特定指令代码变换的指导。

sentences.en: Across general code editing and optimization tasks (e.g., GPU kernel optimization), SemRep outperforms the extensively finetuned baselines with strictly the same training budget by 6.9\% in correctness, 1.1$\times$ in performance, 13.9\% in generalization, and 6.7\% in robustness.
sentences.zh: 在通用代码编辑和优化任务（如GPU内核优化）上，SemRep在严格相同的训练预算下，比经过广泛微调的基线在正确性上高出6.9\%、性能上高出1.1$\times$、泛化上高出13.9\%、鲁棒性上高出6.7\%。

sentences.en: With the improved exploration of diverse code transformations, SemRep is particularly amenable to evolutionary search.
sentences.zh: 借助对多样代码变换的更好探索，SemRep特别适合进化搜索。

sentences.en: Combined with an evolutionary coding agent, SemRep finds optimizations that 685B larger-weight baselines fail to discover while achieving the same performance with 25\% less inference compute.
sentences.zh: 与进化编码智能体结合后，SemRep找到了参数量大685B的基线无法发现的优化，并以少25\%的推理计算量达到了相同性能。

title_en: SENDAI: A Hierarchical Sparse-measurement, EfficieNt Data AssImilation Framework
title_zh: SENDAI：一种分层稀疏测量高效数据同化框架

sentences.en: Bridging the gap between data-rich training regimes and observation-sparse deployment conditions remains a central challenge in spatiotemporal field reconstruction, particularly when target domains exhibit distributional shifts, heterogeneous structure, and multi-scale dynamics absent from available training data.
sentences.zh: 弥合数据丰富的训练条件与观测稀疏的部署条件之间的差距，仍是时空场重建的核心挑战，尤其是当目标域表现出训练数据中不存在的分布偏移、异构结构和多尺度动力学时。

sentences.en: We present SENDAI, a hierarchical $\textbf{S}$parse-measurement, $\textbf{E}$fficie$\textbf{N}$t $\textbf{D}$ata $\textbf{A}$ss$\textbf{I}$milation Framework that reconstructs full spatial states from hyper sparse sensor observations by combining simulation-derived priors with learned discrepancy corrections.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SENDAI，一种分层$\textbf{S}$parse-measurement（稀疏测量）、$\textbf{E}$fficie$\textbf{N}$t（高效）$\textbf{D}$ata $\textbf{A}$ss$\textbf{I}$milation（数据同化）框架，它通过结合仿真导出的先验与学习到的差异校正，从超稀疏传感器观测重建完整空间状态。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the performance on satellite remote sensing, reconstructing MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) derived  vegetation index fields across six globally distributed sites.
sentences.zh: 我们在卫星遥感上展示了其性能，重建了全球六个分布地点由MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）派生的植被指数场。

sentences.en: Using seasonal periods as a proxy for domain shift, the framework consistently outperforms established baselines that require substantially denser observations---SENDAI achieves a maximum SSIM improvement of 185% over traditional baselines and a 36% improvement over recent high-frequency-based methods.
sentences.zh: 以季节周期作为域偏移的代理，该框架持续优于需要密集得多观测的既有基线——SENDAI相比传统基线实现了最大185%的SSIM提升，相比近期基于高频的方法提升了36%。

sentences.en: These gains are particularly pronounced for landscapes with sharp boundaries and sub-seasonal dynamics; more importantly, the framework effectively preserves diagnostically relevant structures---such as field topologies, land cover discontinuities, and spatial gradients.
sentences.zh: 这些增益在具有陡峭边界和季节内动态的景观上尤为显著；更重要的是，该框架有效保留了诊断相关的结构——如场拓扑、地表覆盖不连续性和空间梯度。

sentences.en: By yielding corrections that are more structurally and spectrally separable, the reconstructed fields are better suited for downstream inference of indirectly observed variables.
sentences.zh: 由于所得到的校正具有更好的结构和光谱可分性，重建场更适合下游对间接观测变量的推断。

sentences.en: The results therefore highlight a lightweight and operationally viable framework for sparse-measurement reconstruction that is applicable to physically grounded inference, resource-limited deployment, and real-time monitor and control.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些结果凸显了一种轻量级且可实际部署的稀疏测量重建框架，适用于基于物理的推断、资源受限部署以及实时监测与控制。

title_en: Sentinel-VLA: A Metacognitive VLA Model with Active Status Monitoring for Dynamic Reasoning and Error Recovery
title_zh: Sentinel-VLA：具有主动状态监测的元认知VLA模型，用于动态推理与错误恢复

sentences.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced the field of embodied manipulation by harnessing broad world knowledge and strong generalization.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用广泛的世界知识和强大的泛化能力，推进了具身操作领域的发展。

sentences.en: However, current VLA models still face several key challenges, including limited reasoning capability, lack of status monitoring, and difficulty in self-correction.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的VLA模型仍面临若干关键挑战，包括推理能力有限、缺乏状态监测以及难以自我纠正。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Sentinel-VLA}, a metacognitive VLA model equipped with an active ``sentinel'' module to monitor real-time execution status.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了\textbf{Sentinel-VLA}，一个配备主动“sentinel”（哨兵）模块以监测实时执行状态的元认知VLA模型。

sentences.en: Only when necessary, such as during initial planning or upon detecting an error, the model triggers a dynamic reasoning or formulate error recovery solutions.
sentences.zh: 仅在必要时——例如在初始规划期间或检测到错误时——模型才会触发动态推理或制定错误恢复方案。

sentences.en: This on-demand reasoning mechanism ensures robust decision-making while minimizing computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 这种按需推理机制在最小化计算开销的同时确保了稳健的决策。

sentences.en: Notably, all training data (spanning 44 tasks and over 2.6 million transitions) is automatically generated and annotated through our designed pipeline.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，所有训练数据（涵盖44个任务和超过260万个转变）都是通过我们设计的流程自动生成并标注的。

sentences.en: We also propose the Self-Evolving Continual Learning (SECL) algorithm, which allows Sentinel-VLA to identify its capability boundaries and automatically collect data for expansion, paired with Orthogonal Continual Adapter (OC-Adapter) to constrain parameter updates to an orthogonal space, thereby preventing catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 我们还提出了自进化持续学习（SECL）算法，使Sentinel-VLA能够识别自身的能力边界并自动收集数据以进行扩展，并辅以正交持续适配器（OC-Adapter）将参数更新约束在正交空间中，从而防止灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: Real-world experiments demonstrate that Sentinel-VLA boosts the task success rate by over 30\% compared to the SOTA model, PI0.
sentences.zh: 真实世界实验表明，相比最先进的模型PI0，Sentinel-VLA将任务成功率提升了超过30\%。

sentences.en: We will open-source all the code, weights, and data generation pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我们将开源所有代码、权重和数据生成流程。

title_en: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
title_zh: 将表示与重建分离可实现可扩展的文本编码器

sentences.en: While decoders have rapidly scaled, encoders have remained largely unchanged since BERT.
sentences.zh: 虽然解码器规模迅速扩展，但编码器自BERT以来基本保持不变。

sentences.en: We revisit this disparity by frozen backbone evaluation via probing.
sentences.zh: 我们通过探针冻结骨干评估来重新审视这一差距。

sentences.en: Under this lens, the representations of BERT encoders become increasingly *unexploitable* by frozen probes, despite improved perplexity.
sentences.zh: 在此视角下，尽管困惑度有所改善，BERT编码器的表示却越来越无法被冻结探针*利用*。

sentences.en: The misalignment originates in BERT's flat design, which couples representation learning to the token reconstruction loss.
sentences.zh: 这种错位源于BERT的平面设计，它将表示学习与token重建损失耦合在一起。

sentences.en: We propose **CrossBERT**, a two-part architecture that separates the learning of high-quality encoded representations from the rigid grounding of token reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**CrossBERT**，一种将高质量编码表示的学习与token重建的刚性接地分离的两部分架构。

sentences.en: This design further enables high masking ratios ($\geq 50$%) and gradient collection over all tokens via a *Complementary Masking Strategy*, respectively increasing throughput by $1.5$ to $2\times$ and sample efficiency by $2\times$.
sentences.zh: 这一设计还通过*互补掩码策略*支持高掩码比例（$\geq 50$%）以及跨所有token的梯度收集，分别将吞吐量提高了$1.5$到$2\times$，样本效率提高了$2\times$。

sentences.en: Overall, CrossBERT demonstrates monotonic scaling and superior performance on MTEB(eng, v2) and frozen GLUE benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，CrossBERT在MTEB（英文，v2）和冻结GLUE基准上表现出单调扩展和优越的性能。

title_en: SEPS: Semantic-Enhanced Patch Slimming Framework for Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment
title_zh: SEPS：面向细粒度跨模态对齐的语义增强补丁瘦身框架

sentences.en: Fine-grained cross-modal alignment is pivotal for multimodal reasoning yet remains limited by Semantic Sparsity Bias—a fundamental asymmetry where dense visual signals are under-represented by sparse textual captions.
sentences.zh: 细粒度跨模态对齐对多模态推理至关重要，但仍受语义稀疏性偏差的限制——这是一种根本性的不对称，即密集的视觉信号被稀疏的文本描述所欠表示。

sentences.en: This disparity leads to the inadvertent suppression of contextually vital visual regions (patch redundancy) and hinders precise concept grounding (patch ambiguity).
sentences.zh: 这种差距导致对上下文至关重要的视觉区域（补丁冗余）被无意抑制，并妨碍精确的概念接地（补丁歧义）。

sentences.en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer rich descriptive capabilities, their naive integration often induces semantic drift due to inconsistencies with sparse ground-truth captions.
sentences.zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提供了丰富的描述能力，但其朴素集成往往会因与稀疏真值描述不一致而引发语义漂移。

sentences.en: To systematically resolve these challenges, we present the Semantic-Enhanced Patch Slimming (SEPS) framework.
sentences.zh: 为系统性解决这些挑战，我们提出了语义增强补丁瘦身（SEPS）框架。

sentences.en: Central to SEPS is a novel Dual-Granularity Semantic Calibration mechanism, which synthesizes a Holistic Visual-Linguistic Anchor from MLLMs to synergize with original sparse queries.
sentences.zh: SEPS的核心是一种新颖的双粒度语义校准机制，它从MLLM综合出一个整体视觉-语言锚点，与原始的稀疏查询协同作用。

sentences.en: This mechanism transforms patch selection into a semantic consensus process, ensuring that retained patches satisfy both local discriminability and global contextual integrity.
sentences.zh: 该机制将补丁选择转变为语义共识过程，确保保留的补丁既满足局部可判别性，又满足全局上下文完整性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a Salience-Guided Metric Aggregation strategy to mitigate the similarity dilution effect inherent in global mean pooling, thereby amplifying highly-relevant patch-word correspondences.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了一种显著性引导的度量聚合策略，以缓解全局平均池化固有的相似性稀释效应，从而放大高度相关的补丁-词对应关系。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO datasets demonstrate that SEPS surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches across diverse backbones, delivering significant performance gains in text-to-image retrieval tasks.
sentences.zh: 在Flickr30K和MS-COCO数据集上的大量实验表明，SEPS在多种骨干网络上超越了现有的最先进方法，在文本到图像检索任务中带来了显著的性能提升。

sentences.en: The complete implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SEPS/.
sentences.zh: 完整实现可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SEPS/ 获取。

title_en: Sequential Group Composition: A Window into the Mechanics of Deep Learning
title_zh: 序贯群合成：窥探深度学习机制的窗口

sentences.en: How do neural networks trained over sequences acquire the ability to perform structured operations, such as arithmetic, geometric, and algorithmic computation?
sentences.zh: 在序列上训练的神经网络是如何获得执行结构化运算（如算术、几何和算法计算）能力的？

sentences.en: To gain insight into this question, we introduce the sequential group composition task.
sentences.zh: 为深入理解这一问题，我们引入了序贯群合成任务。

sentences.en: In this task, networks receive a sequence of elements from a finite group encoded in a real vector space and must predict their cumulative product.
sentences.zh: 在该任务中，网络接收来自编码在实向量空间中的有限群的一组元素序列，并且必须预测它们的累积乘积。

sentences.en: This task can be order-sensitive and cannot be solved by a linear model.
sentences.zh: 该任务可能对顺序敏感，且无法由线性模型求解。

sentences.en: Our analysis isolates the roles of the group structure, encoding statistics, and sequence length in shaping learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析分离了群结构、编码统计和序列长度在学习塑造中的作用。

sentences.en: We prove that two-layer networks from vanishing initialization learn this task one irreducible representation of the group at a time in an order determined by the Fourier statistics of the encoding.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，从零初始化出发的两层网络会一次学习该任务中群的一个不可约表示，其顺序由编码的傅里叶统计决定。

sentences.en: To perfectly learn the task, these networks require a hidden width exponential in the sequence length $k$.
sentences.zh: 为完美学习该任务，这些网络需要与序列长度$k$成指数关系的隐藏宽度。

sentences.en: In contrast, we construct deeper architectures that exploit associativity to dramatically improve this scaling: recurrent neural networks can compose elements sequentially in $k$ steps, while multilayer networks can compose adjacent pairs in parallel in $\log k$ layers.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们构建了利用结合律大幅改善这一扩展的更深架构：循环神经网络可以在$k$步内顺序合成元素，而多层网络可以在$\log k$层内在并行中合成相邻对。

sentences.en: Overall, the sequential group composition task offers a tractable window into the mechanics of deep learning.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，序贯群合成任务为窥探深度学习机制提供了一个可处理的窗口。

title_en: Sequential Kernel-based Conditional Independence Testing via Adaptive Betting
title_zh: 基于自适应下注的序贯核条件独立检验

sentences.en: Testing conditional independence is fundamental  yet intrinsically difficult:   without additional assumptions, Type I error control is impossible in general.
sentences.zh: 条件独立检验是基础性的，但本质上却很难：在缺乏额外假设的情况下，通常无法控制第一类错误率。

sentences.en: The ``Model-X'' paradigm addresses this difficulty by assuming exact knowledge of a relevant conditional distribution.
sentences.zh: “Model-X”范式通过假设精确了解相关条件分布来应对这一困难。

sentences.en: While small deviations from this assumption can sometimes be tolerated in classical one-shot testing,    existing sequential conditional independence tests typically require the Model-X conditional to be known exactly,    making them fragile when it must instead be estimated.
sentences.zh: 虽然与这一假设的微小偏差在经典一次性检验中有时可以被容忍，但现有的序贯条件独立检验通常要求Model-X条件分布被精确已知，这使得在必须对其进行估计时它们变得脆弱。

sentences.en: We propose a new approach that is substantially more robust to such estimation error.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种对这种估计误差显著更稳健的新方法。

sentences.en: Our method applies testing-by-betting to an adaptively optimized Kernel Conditional Independence statistic,    together with a normalization scheme and a truncate-and-shift calibration strategy.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将基于下注的检验应用于一个自适应优化的核条件独立统计量，并结合归一化方案以及截断-移位校准策略。

sentences.en: These modifications greatly reduce Type I error inflation while preserving high power   across high-dimensional synthetic benchmarks and real-world fairness tasks, outperforming existing sequential Model-X approaches.
sentences.zh: 这些改进大幅减少了第一类错误的膨胀，同时在高维合成基准和真实世界公平性任务上保持了较高的功效，优于现有的序贯Model-X方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/he-zh/SKCI}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在\url{https://github.com/he-zh/SKCI}获取。

title_en: SERA: Soft-Verified Efficient Repository Agents
title_zh: SERA：软验证的高效代码库智能体

sentences.en: Open-weight coding agents should hold a fundamental advantage over closed-source systems because they can specialize to private codebases, encoding repository-specific information directly in their weights.
sentences.zh: 开放权重的编码智能体应比闭源系统具有根本性优势，因为它们可以专精于私有代码库，将代码库特定信息直接编码到其权重中。

sentences.en: Yet the cost and complexity of training has kept this advantage theoretical until now.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练的成本与复杂性使这一优势至今仍停留在理论层面。

sentences.en: We present Soft-Verified Efficient Repository Agents (SERA), an efficient method for training coding agents that enables the rapid and cheap creation of agents specialized to private codebases.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了软验证高效代码库智能体（SERA），一种高效的编码智能体训练方法，能够快速且廉价地创建专精于私有代码库的智能体。

sentences.en: Using Soft Verified Generation (SVG), we generate thousands of trajectories from any code repository, without requiring unit tests.
sentences.zh: 利用软验证生成（SVG），我们可以从任何代码库生成数千条轨迹，而无需单元测试。

sentences.en: Beyond repository specialization, we apply SVG to a larger corpus of codebases, generating 200,000+ synthetic trajectories.
sentences.zh: 除代码库专精外，我们将SVG应用于更大的代码库语料，生成了超过20万条合成轨迹。

sentences.en: Using only supervised finetuning (SFT), SERA achieves leading results among fully open-source (open data, method, code) models while matching the performance of open-weight models like Devstral-Small-2.
sentences.zh: 仅使用监督微调（SFT），SERA就在完全开源（开放数据、方法、代码）模型中取得了领先成绩，同时达到了如Devstral-Small-2等开放权重模型的性能。

sentences.en: Creating SERA models is 26x cheaper than reinforcement learning and 57x cheaper than previous synthetic data methods to reach equivalent performance.
sentences.zh: 创建SERA模型的成本比强化学习便宜26倍，比以往的合成数据方法便宜57倍，即可达到同等性能。

sentences.en: We use our dataset to provide detailed analysis of scaling laws, ablations, and confounding factors for training coding agents.
sentences.zh: 我们使用我们的数据集对训练编码智能体的扩展定律、消融和混杂因素进行了详细分析。

sentences.en: Overall, we believe our work will greatly accelerate research on open coding agents and showcase the advantage of open-source models that can adapt to private codebases.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们相信我们的工作将极大地加速开放编码智能体的研究，并展示能够适配私有代码库的开源模型的优势。
